| | My good friend Jon Tester is in the toughest race of his career – and it's a race that could very well decide control of the Senate. Republicans have spent tens of millions of dollars to prop up Mitch McConnell's hand-picked challenger to Jon, and the more we learn about this opponent, the more we see just how out of touch he is with Montana's – and America's – values. Take the recent news, for instance: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93431638/500460962/-1705519941?refcode=2024-09-23-nyt&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7232a6f9-077a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjMyYTZmOS0wNzdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4yPvVHrh9FGKqTV43ZT_lYg4inswOaAxEq6dyy8sqGQ=) **Jon's opponent was caught on tape talking about****"a great way to bond with all the Indians out there, while they're drunk at 8 a.m." He also said "they'll let you know whether they like you or not, there's Coors Light cans flying by your head."** It's outrageous for a political candidate to make such disgusting and racist comments about Native Americans. Tribal nations deserve a leader that will respect them and fight for their basic rights and freedoms. **That champion is Jon Tester.** [**Will you help me ensure that Jon wins another much-needed term in the Senate by splitting a donation now between our campaigns?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93431640/500460970/-1705519941?refcode=2024-09-23-nyt&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7232a6f9-077a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjMyYTZmOS0wNzdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4yPvVHrh9FGKqTV43ZT_lYg4inswOaAxEq6dyy8sqGQ=) [Donate Today](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93431641/500460975/-1705519941?refcode=2024-09-23-nyt&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7232a6f9-077a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjMyYTZmOS0wNzdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4yPvVHrh9FGKqTV43ZT_lYg4inswOaAxEq6dyy8sqGQ=) Mocking Indigenous people isn't the only outrageous thing Jon's opponent has been caught saying recently. **He was also taped saying that he wished for abortion to "end tomorrow" and called it "sinful" and "repulsive."** Jon Tester knows that families in Montana value reproductive freedom, and he's steadfastly committed to defending that right. Whether it's abortion rights, strengthening access to health care, taking on dark money in our elections or defending our fundamental freedoms, the difference between Jon Tester and Tim Sheehy is stark. **Tim Sheehy should**** _not_****be in a position to defeat Jon, but because of**** _massive_****outside spending by Republican super PACs, he's very much in the race.** So it's more important than ever – with less than two months to go before Election Day – that we sustain the grassroots support that Jon is counting on. So, if you missed the opportunity to give your testimony, now is your chance! Use your voice for safer, more environmentally sustainable, financially stable, equitable, and well-maintained transportation choices for all Oregonians, by participating in a public hearing. **WHAT: Transportation Roadshow Statewide Virtual Hearing
WHEN: Wednesday, September 25th from 5-7:00 PM
WHERE: Microsoft Teams** [**Sign up here to get the Teams link!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93431749/500461645/1666281383?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA2MTY5YTI0LTA4N2EtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AR9xh69yyPN9o4eYfQSrHcspilsX0lUEgMuU98pshcI=&emci=9619400c-ff79-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=06169a24-087a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=2107230) This summer, The Oregon Joint Committee on Transportation put together a listening tour to gather input from Oregonians in urban, suburban, and rural communities on how to fund and invest in transportation in 2025. [**Register to speak here \- at least 24 hours before the hearing!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93431759/500461650/1666281383?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA2MTY5YTI0LTA4N2EtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=AR9xh69yyPN9o4eYfQSrHcspilsX0lUEgMuU98pshcI=&emci=9619400c-ff79-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=06169a24-087a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=2107230) For those in the Portland Metro area, be sure to keep your eye out for more information on this week’s additional stops in Hillsboro and Happy Valley. name: Shawnna Bolick
subject: Update from the Campaign Trail
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a107f9ead6&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

As you can imagine, I have been super busy and mostly away from my computer to write an update from the trail. Thankfully, it is cooling off a bit overnight. I am very much looking forward to fall.

Our team have been successfully knocking on doors and meeting with voters daily. It is quite apparent taxpayers I speak are motivated to vote come November. They are sick and tired of Biden-Harris’ high inflationary economy and want to keep more of their hard-earned money. More importantly, they love my policy stances and my representation since 2018. My [opponent’s leftist leanings](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f00506bec3&e=a7ab36849c) don’t match our district.

Last week:
* I tossed out another pair of my sneakers because the tread was wearing out and replaced them with the shoes I hope to wear for the next 42 days until the November election. Who knows? I bought another pair of sneakers this morning just in case.
* My campaign released its [second ad](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=46fb82a605&e=a7ab36849c) focused on my opponent’s real record on securing the border. This election is about the future of Arizona. Our communities are suffering from an open border. My opponent has never voted to help law enforcement or to secure our border.
* I had a chance to attend the graduation of Class R-73 for the Phoenix Police Department. The Reserve Academy is a rigorous program. The Phoenix Police Department reserve police officers come from a wide variety of professional backgrounds, including nurses, educators, business owners, firefighters, attorneys, engineers, and so many more. For more information on how you can apply to this highly competitive program, please visit their [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=877a46eca3&e=a7ab36849c).

On September 14th, every piece of legislation the governor signed into law went into effect. Just this past legislative session, the governor signed 9 of my bipartisan bills, 1 [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=17546c2680&e=a7ab36849c) is headed to the November ballot, and another one was transmitted to the Secretary of State to send a post card to Congress showing support for the people and government of Texas in its efforts to secure our nation’s southern Border.

It has become very clear; my general election opponent is too chicken to attack me directly. She redirected a few hundred thousand dollars of her massive campaign cash haul to a leftwing out-of-state Political Action Committee to do her dirty work. One of the latest lies is that I will never get results for your family. Kinda rich coming from a fellow legislator who has yet to have a single bill signed in her four years even with a Democrat governor and I had 9 bills signed just in 2024. Go figure.

As we gear up for the November election, you can get to know the propositions on your November ballot by reading the [publicity pamphlet](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6e99a7fe85&e=a7ab36849c).

We are working on final touches of our Get Out the Vote program. If you’re interested in writing some post cards, making calls, sending text messages, delivering campaign literature to voters, and more, please just reply to this email to let us know how you’d like to help!

Thanks again for your continued support!

Take care,
Shawnna
---
| **Upcoming Events**

9/25 VIP reception and a lunch fundraiser with Governor Ducey in the Biltmore area– seating is very limited. Please RSVP to [info@BolickforArizona.com](mailto:info@BolickforArizona.com) for additional information.

10/4 Evening Meet & Greet in District 2. Light refreshments will be provided. Please RSVP to [info@BolickforArizona.com](mailto:info@BolickforArizona.com) for additional information.

10/10 Evening fundraiser in downtown Phoenix with Senator Janae Shamp, Representative Steve Montenegro, and the Honorable Walt Blackman. Please RSVP to [info@BolickforArizona.com](mailto:info@BolickforArizona.com) for additional information.

* We have a few other events in the works between now and election day. We just haven't nailed down the exact date/venue. More details to follow.*

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
How to vote absentee, knocking doors in Beloit, the Walk to End Alzheimer's in Janesville, and an afternoon with the crew of the USS Beloit. | | | | |
---
| 43 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
**Request Your Absentee Ballot** Voters in Wisconsin can now request an absentee ballot for the November election.
You can request an absentee ballot for any reason. If you aren’t sure that you’ll be able to vote on Election Day, **make a plan to vote early**.
---
[Click Here to Request Your Absentee Ballot](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=334503c3e1&e=e907534017)
| The last day for voters to request an absentee ballot, **is October 31 at 5:00 pm.**
Your clerk must receive your absentee ballot by**November 5 at 8:00 pm** , which is when polls close in Wisconsin.
The U.S. Postal Service recommends mailing back your absentee ballot at least a week before Election Day, October 29, so it gets to your clerk in time.
---
| **Knocking Doors in Beloit** I spent my Saturday knocking doors in Beloit and bringing our message directly to voters. It was great to see so much support!
---
| We had a great team out with us on doors. And we headed over to Tilley’s Pizza House for lunch after we finished knocking doors!
---
| **Walk to End Alzheimer’s in Janesville** I also joined the Alzheimer’s Association at the Walk to End Alzheimer’s in Janesville this weekend.
---
| Alzheimer’s affects over 120,000 people in Wisconsin. And it was inspiring to see so many people come together in hopes for a cure.
---
| **Joining the Crew of the USS Beloit** I enjoyed spending time with the crew of the USS Beloit this weekend.
The USS Beloit has a crew of about 65, but that will grow to about 80 before the ship is placed into service.
---
| The commissioning ceremony for the USS Beloit will take place this fall, which is when the ship will be formally placed into service. I’m thankful for the service of all the crew members.
And I’m thankful for the efforts of the crew to connect with the Beloit community.

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil
---

name: Sen. Gillibrand
subject: a lesson my grandmother taught me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
big change starts small
| | |
---
Look, big change starts small.
That's a lesson that my grandmother, Polly Noonan, first taught me decades ago. Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany.
By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. **She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work, like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can.**
For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. That's how Democrats defeated the odds in 2022 to defend and even expand our Senate majority. And that's why I know that we can win again in 2024.
With Democrats defending 23 seats, the odds are certainly stacked against us. And after the 2022 red wave in New York, Republicans here are already targeting my seat for defeat. **But when people like you get off the sidelines and chip in even just $5, eventually we'll build a grassroots movement capable of defeating even the GOP's wealthiest megadonors.**
**[So please, will you chip in $5 or $25 or whatever you can spare today to help save our Senate majority by building a grassroots movement one gift at a time? clean_body: big change starts small | | | Look, big change starts small. That's a lesson that my grandmother, Polly Noonan, first taught me decades ago. Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany. By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work, like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can. For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. That's how Democrats defeated the odds in 2022 to defend and even expand our Senate majority. And that's why I know that we can win again in 2024. With Democrats defending 23 seats, the odds are certainly stacked against us. And after the 2022 red wave in New York, Republicans here are already targeting my seat for defeat. Friend,

Let's be real here: Floridians know all too well what creepy is.

**It's Rick Scott. He's a creep. **

It's creepy how intent he is on controlling women's bodily autonomy and reproductive choices. He has pushed time and again for a national abortion ban, and would lead the charge in getting such legislation signed into law if Donald Trump gets reelected to the White House.
It's creepy how he voted against the Right to IVF Act, which would have guaranteed federal protections for the procedure. And it's creepy how he _lied about that vote_ — spending millions of dollars on an ad buy saying he would protect access to that very procedure a day after he voted to do the opposite!
The U.S. Senate is one of our world's greatest democratic bodies. It's not a place for creeps and liars, particularly those like Rick Scott intent on pushing the GOP's radical Project 2025 agenda.
**We can and must defeat him: Last time around, Rick Scott spent $64 million of his own money to buy Florida's Senate seat — and he _barely scraped by_ , winning by just over 10,000 votes.**

Look, I'm building coalitions that are much larger than 10,000 votes, and right now, I'm statistically tied with Rick Scott in the polls. But I can't cut my campaign a check for $64 million, nor would I if I could. This is a people-powered movement, and it's _your_ support I need to defeat Rick Scott.

**" Will Hurricane Helene hit Texas? Here's what to know,"** Dallas Morning News'**Sarah Bahari** -- "Forecasters are monitoring a tropical storm system in the Western Caribbean that could turn into Hurricane Helene by midweek.

The storm system -- now called Potential Tropical Cyclone Nine -- is most likely to hit somewhere along the Florida Panhandle or the state's western coast on Thursday, according to an alert from the [National Hurricane Center](https://substack.com/redirect/6b23e6e7-dc71-4aa3-9440-21958a06f818?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

"Environmental conditions appear favorable for further development of this system," the center wrote on its website Monday, adding that residents in the area should have a hurricane plan in place.

Although its ultimate path or strength are not known, the system is expected to produce heavy rains over portions of Central America for the next several days, the agency said.

So will the storm affect Texas? Not likely, said **Sarah Barnes** , meteorologist with the National Weather Service in Fort Worth.

"That's far enough east that we should not see any effects here in the Dallas/Fort Worth area," Barnes said.

https://jenaforcolorado.com/ [https://jenaforcolorado.com/]
Friends –
Earlier this year, I married the best partner I could ever ask for, Mario. Mario has been by my side all these years, and I am so happy that he is now my husband. And, in even more exciting news, Mario and I welcomed our first child, Luca, last month!
It has been an exciting year for our family, and I want to thank you all for the well wishes and support through these personal milestones!
The choice to marry who you love and the choice to start a family should be personal decisions. As now a wife and mother, it’s so important that we protect these freedoms.
Our fundamental rights and freedoms as Americans and as women continue to be under attack. We can protect these rights and freedoms at the ballot box. So, although this is a personal announcement, I had to take the opportunity to make sure you are registered to vote in this upcoming election. You can check your voter registration or register at this link. [https://www.coloradosos.gov/voter/pages/pub/home.xhtml?gad_source=1&gclid=Cj0KCQjwiOy1BhDCARIsADGvQnC0SBT5glWbDgLtu5YIbE8tQqlzROTV8JB3Z1pPlbOmGkJAAwlZ0X8aAh_dEALw_wcB]
Let us work together today to ensure a brighter future for the next generation of Coloradans and Americans. And for those of you keeping track at home, Luca will be eligible to vote in 2042! :)
Wishing you all the best,
Jena Griswold

clean_body: federal law leaves us no choice | | Dear friends, I want to pull back the curtain on why our upcoming deadline on September 30th, 2024 is so important. September 30th is the final day we can fundraise toward our October Quarterly report with the Federal Election Commission (FEC). The minute that this report gets posted online by the FEC, Republican operatives will download the whole thing and begin looking for weaknesses that they can exploit. One of the biggest things they will look at is our fundraising over the quarter, and whether they see signs of Democratic momentum slowing down. IF THEY SEE THAT, it is very likely they will rush dark money reinforcements to the tossup U.S. House districts in our state and try to take back the momentum. As Finance Director, I’ve been poring over the numbers, and I am confident that if we can raise another $30,000 before September 30th, our report will be rock-solid and we’ll go into the last month before the election in a position of strength. body:
Tim is fighting an uphill battle against a career politician who will spend hundreds of millions to cling to power and continue to work against the interests of the people of Montana.

Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znod1jadktmd1sobmbb8qaueitovkrk4imvh7km8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chhm2o72cdh2bs)******************************************************

If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November.

That's just a fact.

While I'm grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, I'd be even more thankful if you took the next step and made a financial contribution to Tim Sheehy's U.S. Senate campaign right now.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3dpom1crci5pjbsf3dvnc6kf6guq0qhlhjlndbg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chhm2o72cdh2bs)******************************************************

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Generational change: Tim's opponent is running for a FOURTH six-year term in the Senate. What can Jon Tester do with another six years in the Senate that he couldn't accomplish in the previous 18?

Transparency: As far as I'm aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim's opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate.

Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zo57tardkfkd0a19e3bn1lmlv80lqhcu0bu2fav0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chhm2o72cdh2bs)******************************************************

If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance.

But having been in the Senate for several years now, I know a couple of things to be true: Democrats cannot do the math. They have no concept of money, what it costs the average American to live, or how to balance a budget. Spending more than you make is a recipe for DISASTER.

Democrats don't understand geography. Despite countless Republican efforts to help them understand the concept of borders, they can't seem to grasp the idea of national sovereignty. Heck, since Joe Biden moved into the White House in 2021, more than 10 million illegal migrants have crossed our "border" illegally.

Democrats fail to understand that religious zealots want us all DEAD. From calling for cease-fires with terrorists to sending money to Iran in exchange for nothing but lies, Democrats have zero concept of what peace through strength means.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjjj8mlf4bb8a34hg7gs63d4d2nlhku2862vp6i0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chhm2o72cdh2bs)******************************************************

As you know, I am running for re-election to the Senate this year and can speak with some authority about what Americans seek in a leader. Tim Sheehy is already a leader, and now I need your help to make him a leader in the United States Senate.

I hope you'll stand with me today in support of this great American, former Navy SEAL, and future United States Senator, Tim Sheehy.

Respectfully,

Ted Cruz

body:
Tim is fighting an uphill battle against a career politician who will spend hundreds of millions to cling to power and continue to work against the interests of the people of Montana.

Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zep7udvdmnqq3q08rkf5d6s5rb9v7r4k2jblovfg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o36cdh2bs)******************************************************

If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November.

That's just a fact.

While I'm grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, I'd be even more thankful if you took the next step and made a financial contribution to Tim Sheehy's U.S. Senate campaign right now.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4abv9haugf81gao6p26kcvuhuau16pfldr61n4g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o36cdh2bs)******************************************************

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Generational change: Tim's opponent is running for a FOURTH six-year term in the Senate. What can Jon Tester do with another six years in the Senate that he couldn't accomplish in the previous 18?

Transparency: As far as I'm aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim's opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate.

Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zms00v079qnsjgl1j8pu35i0ah1jnmo20mheco4o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o36cdh2bs)******************************************************

If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance.

But having been in the Senate for several years now, I know a couple of things to be true: Democrats cannot do the math. They have no concept of money, what it costs the average American to live, or how to balance a budget. Spending more than you make is a recipe for DISASTER.

Democrats don't understand geography. Despite countless Republican efforts to help them understand the concept of borders, they can't seem to grasp the idea of national sovereignty. Heck, since Joe Biden moved into the White House in 2021, more than 10 million illegal migrants have crossed our "border" illegally.

Democrats fail to understand that religious zealots want us all DEAD. From calling for cease-fires with terrorists to sending money to Iran in exchange for nothing but lies, Democrats have zero concept of what peace through strength means.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7k5gv66q48o0r2f7dcfdaqrbkctdlqgfoq3abj8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o36cdh2bs)******************************************************

As you know, I am running for re-election to the Senate this year and can speak with some authority about what Americans seek in a leader. Tim Sheehy is already a leader, and now I need your help to make him a leader in the United States Senate.

I hope you'll stand with me today in support of this great American, former Navy SEAL, and future United States Senator, Tim Sheehy.

Respectfully,

[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0ops47dhvf0niq9b6ibrqjr847o5squit5vvcjg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o36cdh2bs)
Ted Cruz

body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zod615m7s5hak55a29autk68pl03qdgitu0uk3c8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o32cjh2bs)

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztk9rvs8dl4jv61p5ae3jhe2r0sfh67i2cinktjo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o32cjh2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z90hoa4d4pe649eb3lv7m6f21recsv49gjitjtrg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chjm4o32cjh2bs)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

|
Dear Friends & Supporters,
The first day of in-person early voting began on Friday, September 20. You can vote at your local registrar's office or other satellite locations in your county. The last of in-person voting is Tuesday, November 5. Click [here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014ne6O8QDBgmtJeHyauKlrnIyNWQB7c3IFRC8y0J5jB-L5jelKLmgVueQJeq05k2I8KQwrK1J_h2ZtPmW_eMuNijtursAjypJFdk2UISHMLFMyIaLnxfAtGEF9gnw5A4zE5PytsTRR-PvPMYnHaKEOWA8gLtr8RGb8NrxAYI9Hr0=&c=LJlL423Ho4fyaZc-D3glIFIu9cpxddn83oKEEu98r438hA9iMITruA==&ch=PwqQ4wsV_SXz-S6G29kDimX2YGQTCFW8w0_KHdaLzNpcl73Tsl9Djg==) for more details.
While our primary focus right now is winning this November, some of you will also vote in December and January.
If you live in the following counties, you will most likely vote in November, December and January:
APPOMATTOX AMELIA BUCKINGHAM CUMBERLAND PRINCE EDWARD (part) FLUVANNA GOOCHLAND HENRICO (Shady Grove) HANOVER (Western) LOUISA POWHATAN
Now through November, we will vote for President Donald J Trump, Hung Cao for U.S. Senate & State Senator John McGuire for Congress.
Once our ticket wins, in December and January we will focus on filling the state senate seat that will be vacated by State Senator John McGuire. Please be aware that there will most likely be a Republican Mass Meeting in early December, with a Special Election this coming January 7, 2025 to fill the State Senate Seat currently held by John McGuire.
So many of you will vote in November, December and again in January. The location and exact date will be determined once the Governor calls for the Special Election.
I'm told by Republican leadership that no preparation can be done until Governor Youngkin calls for a Special Election, and then within 5 days the Republican Party will have to have a candidate. So please stay tuned.
I've thrown my hat in the ring to finish Senator John McGuire's State Senate Seat.
We need a senator-elect, who has an 8 year proven voting record that you can trust and will hit the ground running on day one. There will be no time for on the job training for the winner, as the Special Election will probably take place the day before session begins.
I've served in the senate for 8 years from 2016-2023 and I'm ready to put my experience to work for the people of Virginia once again. We need a senator who can hit the ground running on day one.
You can trust my conservative 8 year voting record.
100% Family Foundation 100% Virginia Federation of Independent Business 100% VCDL A rating NRA
I'm ready to serve and I humbly ask for your support. If you live in the district, I ask for your vote.
If you don't live in the district, please donate. You may not be able to vote for me but I can vote for you.
Signs, bumper stickers and yard signs are available at all GOP meetings.
Can't make it to a GOP meeting?Reply to this email and we'll be sure to get them to you.
Please email me back with any questions or comments. I will personally reply.

body:
New Jersey and the United States Senate need Curtis Bashaw.

Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state. And I love this country.

I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him,**[join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate. >>](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyUkcGOnSAUhp8Gd9woIFwXLqYx7m7TtGm6JEdEpSNIDjg3ffuGOm26nR05HP5838-Ph36A211YP4O3PXqNIeuAyeh0TvR1pUCjxXQE2DWrmaB1R5nQTTX3smPq3lS2bxRTjZStqqutV3ehoG5520lmhGlBTLAovgg2dffmrirXl5y6Y6JWom3b2wRtt3R3AZOSy9JJImq08Zx2ZyB4-Hmgy79uweZq77ecYyL8hbCRsDFZc6K9PV1AO9_M4QkbCzth4wRpgyc1m7WYaD6o2SCsthhFSOU5H8_stbezOz3hg_XgdsJkGabjRGMJHyL86yIZdDG7I7zvZEP48PUh6V-b97kBH8GtgfDhumm4DqAvngsnH__BzCt9a_SXl2_fP-nXFcF7i_Ta1pfLFXuEbEMmfFjOMCO45MJKmMRSAZYzHzKeljAJPscjuT-sfBAV9nN8un13SSoi6rWIlrKq_JH_fuvZ7wAAAP__gF64qw)**

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn't always easy but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me. After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so called "community" was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: Hatred and Racism. Pathetic.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore. We can look to him to promote prosperity for all--a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States.

There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation's traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy, or at least a good part of it.

**[Please, join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.>>](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyUkcGOnSAUhp8Gd9woIFwXLqYx7m7TtGm6JEdEpSNIDjg3ffuGOm26nR05HP5838-Ph36A211YP4O3PXqNIeuAyeh0TvR1pUCjxXQE2DWrmaB1R5nQTTX3smPq3lS2bxRTjZStqqutV3ehoG5520lmhGlBTLAovgg2dffmrirXl5y6Y6JWom3b2wRtt3R3AZOSy9JJImq08Zx2ZyB4-Hmgy79uweZq77ecYyL8hbCRsDFZc6K9PV1AO9_M4QkbCzth4wRpgyc1m7WYaD6o2SCsthhFSOU5H8_stbezOz3hg_XgdsJkGabjRGMJHyL86yIZdDG7I7zvZEP48PUh6V-b97kBH8GtgfDhumm4DqAvngsnH__BzCt9a_SXl2_fP-nXFcF7i_Ta1pfLFXuEbEMmfFjOMCO45MJKmMRSAZYzHzKeljAJPscjuT-sfBAV9nN8un13SSoi6rWIlrKq_JH_fuvZ7wAAAP__gF64qw)**

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkbuO2zAQRb-G6iTwJSoqWBjQKo3XGyRFSoKPsUyAD4GkNti_D-zYH5B27uDOOZjf7-pd--DTdtER5DUUVapKWt18CLW3pfX1KJ99yGlTFFPe47mnXJHOSUxmx3kHkkx0IkIwgbubFFzTEZzDAI4QZkczGfuNAAAFYybXeXnvwTPleOKCiMGNhMzGCABGzDhaxLEOUNpwLQAuR51c8AZK-yqw59IGm2MX5K21vSJ2QnRFdPXpmocHtNMBBnAHousLH77uS2ytFrEFk3GiF0w5PePT8rG8vf1CVBwtqpqPYgGxZS-57mCbT9sziuD8ERFbIGofnkOr4679lhBbbGmvQ_-inBqkhthy_rh8Vz9O_Xr-2b_EuyLd_seH4KuYEMfbvfSh1f7nBZ-S_g0AAP__XXeQ0g)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkbuO2zAQRb-G6iTwJSoqWBjQKo3XGyRFSoKPsUyAD4GkNti_D-zYH5B27uDOOZjf7-pd--DTdtER5DUUVapKWt18CLW3pfX1KJ99yGlTFFPe47mnXJHOSUxmx3kHkkx0IkIwgbubFFzTEZzDAI4QZkczGfuNAAAFYybXeXnvwTPleOKCiMGNhMzGCABGzDhaxLEOUNpwLQAuR51c8AZK-yqw59IGm2MX5K21vSJ2QnRFdPXpmocHtNMBBnAHousLH77uS2ytFrEFk3GiF0w5PePT8rG8vf1CVBwtqpqPYgGxZS-57mCbT9sziuD8ERFbIGofnkOr4679lhBbbGmvQ_-inBqkhthy_rh8Vz9O_Xr-2b_EuyLd_seH4KuYEMfbvfSh1f7nBZ-S_g0AAP__XXeQ0g)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-iNcEwY88am_Qw16uVtHlw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo1Ra6P0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDkyNFcDc3BjQgpm6-d88mYIlWb1UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-iNcEwY88am_Qw16uVtHlw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo1Ra6P0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDkyNFcDc3BjQgpm6-d88mYIlWb1UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

subject: Reinforcements

body:
Tim is fighting an uphill battle against a career politician who will spend hundreds of millions to cling to power and continue to work against the interests of the people of Montana.

Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5GY46Y9dfnpjAoRmERB3MQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November.

That's just a fact.

While I'm grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, I'd be even more thankful if you took the next step and made a financial contribution to Tim Sheehy's U.S. Senate campaign right now.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5GY46Y9dfnpjAoRmERB3MQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Generational change: Tim's opponent is running for a FOURTH six-year term in the Senate. What can Jon Tester do with another six years in the Senate that he couldn't accomplish in the previous 18?

Transparency: As far as I'm aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim's opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate.

Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5GY46Y9dfnpjAoRmERB3MQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance.

But having been in the Senate for several years now, I know a couple of things to be true: Democrats cannot do the math. They have no concept of money, what it costs the average American to live, or how to balance a budget. Spending more than you make is a recipe for DISASTER.

Democrats don't understand geography. Despite countless Republican efforts to help them understand the concept of borders, they can't seem to grasp the idea of national sovereignty. Heck, since Joe Biden moved into the White House in 2021, more than 10 million illegal migrants have crossed our "border" illegally.

Democrats fail to understand that religious zealots want us all DEAD. From calling for cease-fires with terrorists to sending money to Iran in exchange for nothing but lies, Democrats have zero concept of what peace through strength means.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5GY46Y9dfnpjAoRmERB3MQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

As you know, I am running for re-election to the Senate this year and can speak with some authority about what Americans seek in a leader. Tim Sheehy is already a leader, and now I need your help to make him a leader in the United States Senate.

I hope you'll stand with me today in support of this great American, former Navy SEAL, and future United States Senator, Tim Sheehy.

Respectfully,

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5GY46Y9dfnpjAoRmERB3MQ~~/AARclAA~)
Ted Cruz

body:
I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=2f0b2af482254373bed2a57061925965&_e=lvxl3gLrWCtPaA7_JjqXrD4uLcwxL76jqSTjo1TeCE_ghh9GS5S2bWk5_60uz7fpN283HxBl0NNzpJIDozHdhYsQf_TY1NaB28bzG8CzJe0M_04h4a9X52yXrpk2iOwmRJQ_Xu1wdqmzRzSclaTUCJkE6UA4TGGrtdNmHNWGhoRQYM7DIz1myer1Arsi5mQlUK9dy2pEA2goR9WiCPjS7ZB1Gk75U-6WeGmHP2mel5PhrGiHcJlD_PKUmTHMAF26DRJLOvgw5BipMc9gQ1klDx7MR-3pW-Ucxi6sILwP7aIwZ1y_zFsxm6-B47rs9lWk_tLMy_oFa_chnIMPf5d_tiA1SLnrpNND7tIbXd_li1-b3r825ug1ycuw1w3FTXle)

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=2f0b2af482254373bed2a57061925965&_e=lvxl3gLrWCtPaA7_JjqXrD4uLcwxL76jqSTjo1TeCE_ghh9GS5S2bWk5_60uz7fpN283HxBl0NNzpJIDozHdhYsQf_TY1NaB28bzG8CzJe0M_04h4a9X52yXrpk2iOwmRJQ_Xu1wdqmzRzSclaTUCJkE6UA4TGGrtdNmHNWGhoRQYM7DIz1myer1Arsi5mQlUK9dy2pEA2goR9WiCPjS7ZB1Gk75U-6WeGmHP2mel5PEUQ8bT3-dKbuu65r38hCeKsTVB3TWKVIaGlR_jnXqQUArbRCB_Q6FcDF0prF5VKbXR5S-C0UHCAZNbO074YAIF0W5osz34tE1vjksx2njoGgdhxJMJV4wuEqmH7vjprbhZH3cgVuGN_jL7bGDX6Fi)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=2f0b2af482254373bed2a57061925965&_e=lvxl3gLrWCtPaA7_JjqXrD4uLcwxL76jqSTjo1TeCE_ghh9GS5S2bWk5_60uz7fpN283HxBl0NNzpJIDozHdhYsQf_TY1NaB28bzG8CzJe0M_04h4a9X52yXrpk2iOwmRJQ_Xu1wdqmzRzSclaTUCJkE6UA4TGGrtdNmHNWGhoRQYM7DIz1myer1Arsi5mQlUK9dy2pEA2goR9WiCPjS7ZB1Gk75U-6WeGmHP2mel5N3TEu2fUBs2V4UH68vxWwQWFk7IMZ2eH7xroGZ5Od8kIq_gqISbIdH2QELRPlrjNcDZHX8r_wEB3g-MIxIDkE4sXlFOHRQsUsWBqgH7-r2RdoLab9f41VwUvfjUon65LyY5ezkwEy2tA936uP3pX-i)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

# TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this day in 1789, [the Judiciary Act](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GO6yAQheGnsTssGMZwKShuky7bbmlhPI5nhUMEJJbffrXRltuerzj6P6_TNXDi--0j7OTbmqcQG79ocgJQAE7YL34lAtI9eWXBqn_GKtdv3lGYNeh5dAYcjaORJNGgsnN0erGqZw8SUDpAJaVFM0g9R4wIYQyrtkZ1KGnhlsvwlfneNlrTmV9Uhpj3PvmttUft9P8OLh1cjuMYNq4tl_PHO7i0jatYwin4Ln7lvZJYudQm6vNRaCcR87O0vvjlcXBKXI3tUN72wOl91P7Ofnn4DgAA__8KU1rz), signed by President Washington, established the six-justice Supreme Court, with John Jay nominated as chief justice and five others as associate justices, all confirmed by the Senate on Sept. 26. How would you like to walk outside your home and see a bull wandering nearby? That happened in Massachusetts when [eight bulls turned fugitive](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQheGnMZ2RPczaULi4Dd3eNiUazHhxZPAKe0F5-2ijlOk-6RRH-j_u051iivvjP23sasgT-RpPngYJKAEnbBYXmIG7hp22YHVvrB6a1dneq6B75LAAzIMiewt61sjGUEC0TXSgANUAqJWyaFrVzR49At0odNZogYqXWPPRfua415VD-sonH63PW5PcWuuziO6fgFHAeF1Xu89-56u8dwHjmwLGV5G_ml8pFcnF05PlkRfOcqNSyK-vwrUWefidtAXd2-Zwy_OKKcVirED12Cimn9_6d4XTwXcAAAD__8oHX80) after escaping from a local rodeo. Now we're curious: Have you ever been to a rodeo? Let us know in our poll below. We're flying today with our sponsors at [LMNT](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GurNgWcNRULzG3b02pUWW9XkTbE4-5Ch_HyVKmXpGI83Lbb5lqbLf_-eNU1_anKnLyXO8AF4AZ9QlLczATnOyAYK9-mCjXhNlRyMZiGGEawE_kiNDzBAhBoSiJYEBNBHQGhPQD8a9EhJCHvPigrcKDRfp7Rjemux95aV-tpOPgdqma1p7fzyV-6dgUjCVQ_b3uu39myqYfl19pPL4kFrl6YNCc9-y1J9A_3vnTPAVAAD__94YTGE), the sugar-free way to stay hydrated.

## Israel Steps Up Attacks on Hezbollah
Israel launched [massive airstrikes on Lebanon](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu5CAUheGnwR0WXLPGFBTbuJttt7QucBmTMDDCxFby9NGkTnekrzn6_9-2G6acyv0fPsj2WDf0PZ20GQ6Kg9rUEGwkApoGslKDlsuspRl264SP0SzKTcGhUXGeTDBuFrhoL8iFIVkQoIQBJYXQah7F5LzyCvAPxknPkilBIfXaxreaSt8p5s96Uht9fQzZ7r0_Dzb9ZbAyWK_rGovzha7j5QzW13xBbTkwWNPRkDLP5LDUwnf6cjVn3Dmd6D-wp1r40Vt6p4M3X1BqkIsYmg3PK-WcjlkzJe4PTPnnQP89x2nhOwAA__8fcGQm) Monday, hitting more than 1,300 alleged Hezbollah targets, killing nearly 500 and wounding over 1,600, potentially signaling a broader military campaign.Monday's bombing was [the deadliest day of fighting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQRb8Gd1gwJtguKLZxl223tAY8xLOLTQQo1ubrn_Lq113p6uhI5899vSMnPh-_8SDXYl4xNH7ROkswEsxqus1FIqChI6dHGPVkRz13u7Mxzj7oyZtwmwfAQd-Umjac7OxtxNixAwVGzWC0UqOxvRp8MMEA3jAOo9XCKNq45dL_zXy2nWL6n19U-pCPLrm9tWcVwy8Bi4Dluq4--HrSVT-_gOUzBSxcC1KSiTye-ZQ7vX1OCXd5YZEPfKPc8cAqeYsSudRW-B99wK647XlxSlztKIx6HMjp291-LvFy8BUAAP__uHBiKw) between the two groups since the 2006 Israel-Hezbollah war.Before the airstrikes, [Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb_G7ohgIGAKiteky2u3tMYwxLPCxjIo0e7Xr7L1lldXRzo6H_f5jlx4f_zHjULPdcbY-UmzF2AEmNmMKWQiID1SUA6cmqxTflzDlH1UYEnbSXu0SwKpsic5pYTXlNzIASQY6cEoKZ2xF6mXaKIBvGLWzqrBSErc63n5rLz3lXL5qk86L7FuYwlr70cb9L8BbgPc8Njp1d7Xe5ydY6EBbtxOpCIOLNQ674x7Eytu2MQLT_FGRKEF97qLlb6XWgqugnREHydtDcirzd5CTtlZrTzpZUo0niEdLy6Fm3WDkY8Nufxa9b8bPQP8BAAA___IOGlI) released a recorded message, urging Lebanese civilians to evacuate and to take the warning seriously. He also said they could return safely after the operation was completed.Pentagon officials revealed Monday that the [U.S. will deploy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7ohgWQMuKF6TLq-90lqvl5gTMZGNHN19_SlXXzmaZjQft-lGueTt_p8eEluqE3HLp0yjAlSAE_ZLTCIgtpdoPHgTnDdjv0ZGFi_eGlgSeas5DTKI5pCCD7Md-xxBA-oR0Gjt0V20nRkZgQZK1jvToZYlt7pfPmve2iqpfNVT9gvXR1_i2trz6Oy_Dq4dXOm5yet4qzfsLXORDq752EmKKjLTVjd15lpkY1Ev2tUq33MthVblLJkhkR01jUic0EkKwTEPaQ5hmfs9Ls9XLiUfzneo7w_K5Tej_T3ljPATAAD__7KUZCw) a limited number of troops to the Middle East in response to recent events, though they withheld specific operational details.
## Suspect's Note Details Plan to Shoot Trump
Ryan Wesley Routh, accused of an assassination attempt on former President Donald Trump, left a [note detailing his plan](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3O4yAQAJ_G7ogwrMEUFNeky7VXWmu8JBvhH8Em0b39KVd_5Wia0fy5zTfkwvv9N24UJR8zJuE3zUEZUAZm6NeYiQzZnuLgjR8m54fQPyI5F9C5JY2TWyxo68ZE1nlciUKA3HM02oAOBgatPbiLtkuCBAZHzNa7oQNNK8tRL8-Dd3lQLn-PN9VLOra-xIfI2Tr7qzPXzlzx3OnTvuoLVTgV6sxV6ms7FbaGrfGOwseuUIS2U1QuR-UVVV5YPV9NOJFa6cQqG-2iBhPGAQDdmMHpMSSyYYGUVm-mKS-pr3E9P1wKN-c70PcNufxvk59PvaP5FwAA__9o7mup) and offering $150,000 for someone else to complete the act if he failed, according to the Justice Department._" This was an assassination attempt on Donald Trump but I failed you,"_ the note read. _"I tried my best and gave it all the gumption I could muster."_ Prosecutors also found a list of Trump's appearances and searches on how to travel [from West Palm Beach to Mexico](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOhCAQQL8GOwyMrGhBcY3dXnulQRx254JiZFZyf3_Zq697ySte8r7u891Tov3x6Td0HPPsA9OF8yjBSDCzaVYXEQG7Bp22YPXQWz02T9ejARsjxnEcBlyVXzqr7bLoaG59GIaGHCgwagSjlbKmb1W3BBMM-JuPne21MApX4ny235l2fmJMP_nCsw15a5J7Mh9FdB8CJgFTrbUNS9mxlrcXML1RwMTnazukL8WXQrtnyrv0zLgdLMurHBhY7ljliuwpFRny62QBU3O69aiUEpXeCqMem6f0l-b_R1wOfgMAAP__sSJiqg) in Routh's car.Trump's campaign called the charges against Routh a "slap on the wrist" and blamed the "Kamala Harris/Joe Biden Department of Justice and FBI" for [mishandling the case](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGngY4bWDaiBUUau0ub0kFcz82AOMJ5k7fPJHXqv_hnvs_7dA-ceH98hEy-rWUKsfFF06AAFeCEcvErEZCV5I0DZ_rOmUFufkDoUVttdMTOAkI_LBBnM5MzFmct2YMG1AOg0dphd9N2jhgRwltYreuMQE0Lt3LevgrvbaM1fZeLzlssWSa_tXZUYd8FjALGttHGKf02AeNWMu30qgLGGPIR-LELGLEfsDdatfOZDxVifFaqap1ZhVpDrbyHxmVXoTXKRxMwytMvx4tT4to5gfqRA_89ZPtf4_LwEwAA__-hfGE7).
## New Mozart Work Discovered
A [previously unknown composition](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7tu6zAQBb-G6iRQq7VoFSxuo863TSmsyaXNhA9DpE04Xx8odboDHGAG83HZLuSDT7f_FFlXlzcy1b94W3rAHnDDzmrHDDx1rEcFajzPaly6u5bG4dmMqNwsidnNlk7mSkotFpDk1HkNElAugKOUCudBTleDBoFO5CY1jwIlW1_zPnxmn-qdXXjnF--DybEL-l7ro4jpn4BVwNpaG8y1JG7l-AWsxxSwPtNXyi318Vm86WP-pr321hdzoNj2N94jpbeAtdu1fTQfgi-zEihvkXz4ldW_018afgIAAP__Zo1dXg) by a teenage Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart has been discovered in a German library.The piece, titled _Ganz kleine Nachtmusik_ , consists of seven miniature movements for a string trio and lasts about 12 minutes. [Listen to it here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvgzAQRn-NvQXZ5wuGwUOlKls6VUKd0GHOwa2JEXFA-fcVnbt-n96TXnftrxRTvN8-aGZXQu7Jl7hx354AT4A9ytEFZmAj2WkLVje11a2cXMA6MAKdz6Gh1mhlBktE6BvkZtSDjA4UoGoBtVIW60qZwaM_EArG1lqg4jGWvFbfOd7LxCG98sZr5fMsk5tKWR7CvAm4CLjs-1698rM8Bz7-Y6HiJ2EumzDv3c-2dE1_-py_5OrGZY8pxUdtBarbTDH9Kcv_gZuD3wAAAP__uHNSWA).Experts believe Mozart composed the work in his early teens, around the mid-to-late 1760s.The newly discovered piece had its world premiere in Salzburg, Austria, on Monday, coinciding with the 40th anniversary of the release of the [Mozart biopic _Amadeus_.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFv8yAQQH8NbLHgOEM8MHzSJ2_p0KXdrDM-YlocIofYSn59lc5d35Oe9D5Ow4lSTpfzGy3saywDhZo2HroD4AFwQDn5yAxsJHvtwOmjdbqTsyegEYGOECYHbeA46njsLFnbgoptJ5MHBag6QK2UQ9soMwYMCNRSNM5qgYqnVMvafJV0qTPH_Cgbr00oi8x-rvV6E-afgF5Av-978yj3eh_55V-EapiF6Tdh_g_vGMfp-fws33L103VPOaebdQLVeaGUf5P178HNw08AAAD__7HoUoY)

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

Hi, friend, it's Debbie. I just got out of an urgent early-morning meeting with my campaign team, and I wanted to get a note out to you about where things stand right now. It’s important.
Unfortunately, we're pacing 28% behind where we should be to hit our final $6 million end-of-quarter goal. **[_Will you donate $5 to help get us back on track so we can defeat Rick Scott?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93434742/500506054/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk2029-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDNjMzUzYzctNjI3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9EyKaL-W_PnA9phjx0Py38aCzV0nrPKzl8hzHxpP0Ao=)**
We cannot afford to fall behind now that we're just 42 days away from the November election. My opponent, Rick Scott, is one of the richest senators in the country, so he's more than capable of self-funding his campaign. In fact, he’s already poured millions into his current campaign, and last time around, he spent $64 MILLION of his own fortune to buy this seat.
Look, friend, I’ve already competed against opponents like Rick Scott and _won_. I’m not afraid to face him or anybody who doesn’t put Florida first — especially as he continues to get rich while taking away our rights, abusing our government, and raising costs for families. _Ya n_ _o más_. We’re going to do something about it. We’re going to win.
But winning will take staying ahead of our grassroots goals, especially when Rick Scott can cut himself a massive check at any moment. **[_That’s why I’m asking, friend: Please, help me make up this gap by donating $5, or whatever you can, to defeat Rick Scott, win in Florida, and expand our Senate majority._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93434743/500506055/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2029-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDNjMzUzYzctNjI3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9EyKaL-W_PnA9phjx0Py38aCzV0nrPKzl8hzHxpP0Ao=)**

## East Texas Police Captain Awarded $21 Million
A federal jury awarded a former East Texas police captain $21.35 million for [being wrongfully terminated](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFyqzAQRb9GdGKkRTZQqHgNnV-bklmkxWgsJCI2YP99xpm0Ke_cU5w5H7fxhiGGdP-PK1l-znlEx-GgsZdgJJjRVN5Oyve6IqtbaHWnoNPVYk3boGs6DdRePEwGezN3DlvVI-lG-ypYUGBUD0aryxV0fVHdBKS00Y2G3k_CKPKBc6l5IaYn7nN85YNK7fJaRbswb7to_gkYBAznedYP4sf7FDAkOncBQ8wOo_wdcy4rFfn5FXjFJLccgyPpcGMMSeKJxZOXay4kecEkQcs1xBhykgcVHxxLvGNIO0sX-CVgqIr12_lm9msrjLqvGOKPHv9R67DwHQAA__9QKW7K) after local officials retaliated against him for exercising his First Amendment rights. Terry Bevill was [fired from the Quitman police department](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOpDAQRL_GZD2ymwabgOASsr30QtSY9oxPBo-Md9j9-xNz8WYttapeVf35mD84prjff_MmY_0KeWZf40vmAZAAaaZmHRe9DqaR0Vi0xml0pnmMxppFUHfkRIiGobOGe2O9c-3SDs43cUSNpAcko7seza3TbkHRhkxrcFgXRVrWWHO51YdU-eIjpO_8knLzeWvS-Kj1eaj2l8JJ4XSe5-0MzNdT4cSlRp9E4bTLeSicUvacFE5_P8s38MllPeAyAzSwxZRi3qFmCLlsUkD4qPBmwjOn6AVyCNFLgbPk_R4-E1QpW9y5XsIilVP8f_vEcbuInTbQWedxIQuuWxcgGzpwdmmhl8DO9jRQoKaM6_O8Ihy9VaTvG8f07lh_mPw14r8AAAD__wnwg1I) after filing a personal affidavit requesting a change of venue for a friend accused of criminal activity due to publicity about the case. He also alleged conflicts of interest among local prosecutors, law enforcement, and court personnel. Bevill was subsequently [charged with aggravated perjury.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFv8yAYhH8N3rDgNcT2wBB9-hgqpe0QKaOF7ZcYCUMEJE7-feW2a_fnntPd5TScjPMuXN_Niqo8bRzMVNwDh56CoCAGUc1qZHPPK1S8hZZ3DDpeLQpGKyVjXMi-k2K2LXI7jRx60yBnh6lyChgI1oPgTB6A15J1IyDjgjcc-nkkguHsSkx1WbDg02TrX_GBqZ7iWnm1lHLLpDkS0AT0tm31eM8uYM6bS7hDBHTALRPQS1yRgP5tZC0TQgIBjYGAPu9u-nZPL3rcTJozBV43kp6c9y4GWiLVMa2Y6H-TC_3BP6N3E9IPa92EibpALymGq717esa0umDKnv3njVurpObbttvyoSWCXVfj_PeK8sepDwVfAQAA___hgHju) Although he was eventually cleared of wrongdoing, he had to sell personal property to provide for his family.
## Houston Billionaire Buys English Soccer Team
Houston billionaire Dan Friedkin has [agreed to purchase](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAQQL8GOwzMsioFxTV2e-2VZoRxJUExMNHdv7_c9te_5L28n8f0wJji_vzGjRy_ljyh53jSZCUYCWYyTXCzClY35HQPvR4UDLpZnfLBKwA03sIy4NzbcO861fvuZsOMSxMdKDDKgtHq3oFu72qYgZQ2-qbBhlkYRSFyLi2vxPTCuqR3Pqm0Pm9NcivzUcXtS8AoYLyuq93eFXfcOe8x_0ECxnrkwlXAiIWjTyRgpJMK510WQr9SlfgsRBvtLK_Iq_yY5IyVgtS2HzrV2fZYj6a4cFwxpVi7Xhj13DCmTwr_c-Z08BsAAP__TRNnlA) English Premier League soccer team Everton F.C. from British-Iranian businessman Farhad Moshiri for an undisclosed sum. The son of a successful auto dealer, Friedkin is [worth an estimated $7.6 billion](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LuOrDAQBNCvMZlRuzEPBw5uQjY33RD50QzWGjwyBmb-fsXmm5VU0lGpvh7Tw4QYtud_s5Iu7zlNxpVw0qQ4So5ykpXXFrwSFWnRYy8GwEFUi-4GMNTbDr2fxeDbWc09CgWib7EBC1XQCChBoRTQdijqFgaLBEKKRqDylkkgH0rKdVmo0Nvsc_ykk3Lt0lpFvZTy2lnzj-HIcLyuq3abdXfJcLxthiOoOzcMx2PnNsQY0mZCJu7NxuccyH-HjZtnJtp5SdweH06vyPfkHGXu4mE5nZRL2ni9lDVWWfvXdUN71zMJz9WE-Duo_PHPqfEnAAD__62gZx0) and has investments in entertainment and hospitality venues and the Italian soccer team AS Roma.

His company previously loaned Everton 200 million pounds, which could be converted into equity. Everton F.C. is one of the oldest and most successful clubs in England, but it has [struggled in recent years](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwTWK7oHgNXV67pQXmktxdDBGwdvL3K2-_3Uij0Rydj9tysxQp3f_bDXV7hbzYtdGOy8xBcVCL6rx2ws-yQy1HGOUkYJLdQw-D83aWAYMQV-enISjpgxsEKHQjrB1pEKDEDEqKyxVkfxGTAxRSyUHC7B1TAj21XPr2wIYvW0N85x1Lv-ati_rR2rOy4R8Dw8Acx9GHXBzWs2ZgKjWsDMyn3bAmG1tODMz5ycCI-cwDA-MoRsrJUkHubeKhEPovSnzNKVDZKvdoI2-Zu-83xx1Ly4mHlYHpivbP49zX68iUuG-W4i9c-8PVruEnAAD__9L3bBU) and has been looking for a buyer for several months.
## Police Robot Outsmarts Criminal
Lubbock police [deployed a crime-fighting robot](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3PozAQhH-N6TayN4ZA4eIaulx7JTL2OlgyGNlLPv79ibz124xGGunRo_l3n-42prg9_tqVDL9Dnqzj-KRpANSAetKNN7P0g2rIqBveVC-xV81i9DyHntpgrZNXr7peatdjUNS54Lxrm2hQopYDaiXbDtWllf2MJJVWV4WDn4WW5CPncuGFmN62hvTJTyoXl9cmmYV5r-L6R-AocNw-e658TgLHkyxwlIPAUZ1xVNjoVQWO9ag7OYa4wZcJle3mcwjAJVIFzlCXnBn2nKIjKHnODPPBEBnywXW1hSsscYVybD_llBI4NsX4_RVTirW7CS0fq43pK8u_fPc0-D8AAP__XKRzFQ) to apprehend a suspect who had barricaded himself in a motel room last week. Wanted for a parole violation, 39-year-old Felix Delarosa got in a shootout with investigators at a Lubbock Days Inn, prompting law enforcement to [send in a bomb squad robot](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGynDAMRb8GOu3YwjygoEiz3UubcsfYAjTjtRhbu2z-PkNSp7rFOdJI99f349tz4rz99E-a9bPKwwflNz0mQAfoHq6N82LiZFua7YCDHQ2Ott3nbumGLk7jEmPoPfaD7-00ro4ojhO6peUZDTozobOm_0J76824IBnrbGdxikvjDEVWKTfdSenj65p-y5vKLcizTfOuetSm-9HgvcH7eZ63JMEnixdv8J7prFd4ZclwSkmxwXuRRRSCHFBeGa51sPkKSr5APb3CJVz40p4-7JwJDkkcCGRdOVCBqj5HWVeor3pQUPClUFWou4hy3mB75bqLXgkn-UMy1J0KXyOZDyqQaRPlf6ftopTaMsfj5JS4fg2NM9vTc_r7qf6n-PeMfwIAAP__l7WM9Q) to get him to surrender. Delarosa tried to disable the robot by shooting it and throwing a sheet over it, but the robot sprayed tear gas through a broken window.

When Delarosa exited the room, the robot drove on top of him, pinning him to the ground and allowing authorities to take him into custody. Peter, In just six days, we need to close the books on this quarter’s fundraising progress. **On one hand, this is like any other fundraising deadline we’ve been through together.** Our leadership and finance teams dug into the progress we’re making against our 2024 goals and calculated what we need to raise in order to turnout enough votes to elect our pro-democracy leaders across the country. **And on the other hand, this is so, so different from our normal fundraising deadlines. Because this is the _LAST_ EOQ before November’s election.** There are 170 Democracy Defenders who are counting on us to show up for them in this last sprint towards November. These types of races are often decided by just _hundreds_ of votes, so every dollar towards voter education and turnout really makes a difference. Our team has done the careful work of identifying the state-level races that are _the most essential_ to protecting and strengthening democracy around the country. body:
Please let me explain why this is so important TODAY of all days:

| |

---
| | | It pains me to even ask you but at this point, I don't know what else to do.

_**[So- with a humble heart - can I ask you to pitch in $35 before our final End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline of the election?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztajevrcs7v8nsnnc754211oqriqa67cubvcqg08_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chie8o71c5h2bs "So – with a humble heart – can I ask you to pitch in $35 before our final End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline of the election?")**_

**But first, let me explain why this is so important TODAY of all days:**
* Last weekend, Kamala _shattered her record_ by raking in $27+ million in a single night
* Last week, we got word that House Democrats _doubled_ our fundraising total in August
* As of this morning, we're dangerously behind with only a few hours left before our _most important_ fundraising deadline to date

I'd be a fool if I didn't tell you the truth point blank.

If we fail to reach our goal, Kamala Harris and the Democrats will have a major advantage heading into these final days. Our Conservative candidates in key states - like Pennsylvania, Arizona, Georgia, and Texas - would be left defenseless at the most critical time of the election.

**And if that happens, nothing would stand in the way of the Democrats taking COMPLETE CONTROL of our country. **

So that's why I'm sending you this email as fast as I can. There's still a window of opportunity to fix this but I really need your help before our key deadline. If $35 is too much, I completely understand. **_[Could I ask you for $20 or even $10? Any amount would be GREATLY appreciated while there's still time.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqj86bhv7oqhd5r3lpob2bgfq0c9i4e37d60bf7o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chie8o71c5h2bs "Could I ask you for $20 or even $10? Any amount would be GREATLY appreciated while there’s still time. ")_**

---

This is the most important message I've sent you in a LONG time. The truth is, this is an election-defining fundraising benchmark. That's why so many top Conservatives have emailed you recently.

- Tulsi Gabbard reached out
- Newt Gingrich reached out
- Donald Trump Jr. reached out
- John Kennedy reached out
- Mike Pompeo reached out
- Byron Donalds reached out
- Sarah Huckabee Sanders reached out

Now I'm reaching out ONE LAST TIME because time is quickly running out and I don't know where else to turn. _**[Whether you can afford to pitch in $100, $35, or even just a few bucks, I just ask you to pitch in something.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zj59o1eglumn3ruft00vo6t61v5ql5262qsqqjm8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7chie8o71c5h2bs "Whether you can afford to pitch in $100, $35, or even just a few bucks, I just ask you to pitch in something.")**_

Regardless, thanks for all you've done for our country.

God bless you,
Steve Scalise

name: Hillsdale College via Old Glory Today
subject: Share your thoughts on CRT and its influence
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MQc_OC-P6nW3mlhzhp3I8A~~/AARclAA~/RgRo1USqP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDkyNFcDc3BjQgpm63208mYrhwGxUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MQc_OC-P6nW3mlhzhp3I8A~~/AARclAA~/RgRo1USqP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDkyNFcDc3BjQgpm63208mYrhwGxUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MQc_OC-P6nW3mlhzhp3I8A~~/AARclAA~/RgRo1USqP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDkyNFcDc3BjQgpm63208mYrhwGxUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MQc_OC-P6nW3mlhzhp3I8A~~/AARclAA~/RgRo1USqP0SdaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY3J0LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDE1NzJOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNydHN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDkyNFcDc3BjQgpm63208mYrhwGxUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1983%2E135344%2EFLUOFt)

Friend --
Sometimes I look through my inbox at the endless barrage of emails from political campaigns and organizations and I wonder how anyone donates at all?
Some campaign has a triple-match offer (it's fake.)
Another campaign has an "official mid-month fundraising deadline” (not a real thing.)
And if you're inclined to donate, how do you choose between all the messages you’re getting?
First, I am grateful you've even opened this email. In the sea of political emails, even that is a small win (and it happens to help ensure our emails get into inboxes and not spam, so thank you.) These messages are important to me: I write or edit every single email that comes from me.
As you read this, outside groups are spending huge sums of money to defeat us, Donald Trump is coming back to Michigan later this week to rally his base in the state, early voting begins soon, and we have an actual FEC fundraising deadline in less than a week.
So please. This is a strategically important moment to donate to this campaign.
There's no way I could expect you to donate to every email we send, but I hope you will give to this one.
[**Can I count on you to use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, to my campaign for U.S. Senate?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240924-1&t=2&akid=1983%2E135344%2EFLUOFt)**

body:
