Dear USO Supporter,
As a military spouse, I know the sacrifices our brave service members make every day. The weight of their duty hangs heavy on their shoulders, yet they bear it with unwavering courage and dedication. **But behind every person in uniform stands a family, carrying our burdens, fears and silent struggles.**
Life at home keeps on going during a deployment. A family member falls ill, holidays come and go, our friends get married. In all of these moments, I wish my husband was here. And truthfully, it's more than just wishing he could be here for these moments. When he is deployed, I live with a constant fear that I won't ever hear from him again. When he calls me from a USO Center, it is both confirmation that he is alive and the reassurance I rely on to keep going.
The USO has been a beacon of support for military members and their families, like ours, going all the way back to World War II. Right now, service members are still being deployed, carrying the weight of separation and uncertainty, while their loved ones live in constant worry. **I can personally tell you that in these times of uncertainty, the need for USO programs that support military families is greater than ever.**
Our service members still need the USO to provide the vital support and resources that give them hope on the darkest of days. That means the USO is counting on the generosity of people like you to continue their crucial work of connecting service members and their families and helping us make it through long deployments and every season of sacrifice.
**So, I 'm asking you to join me in making a difference in all our lives today. Your donation of $29, or anything at all, can provide a much-needed lifeline to service members and those who love them, even when we're thousands of miles apart. [Please, make your donation to the USO today.](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/YWdETY-g3KM0/VGRVVkExK3lmcHRpdjhuSWczMFpjbWc4djlCQlRJWDFodDFQZGpMUzZ1d2ZpQkxvaVM2N0YxcnpreGN4MkZYNHQyck50SnR1dk1ZcUxKbFkwUjlXM0VnNlM1VHdZNThFVlVoeGxMUUQwVnM9S0/YVNxUDNXaDlmaXZ3a1k5Vzh6TWNWdTB4VWg1cjlwZG5rR0xENWRnandoaXJQWXZ1b01ZRW1jNVpqRUZpZ1B5NEJHN0pFbzV6Uzg1eXo5YkduVUxpS3AwSU5zNE5DUTBrS0)**
Together, we can show our heroes that they are not forgotten and that everyone here at home is holding them close to our hearts.
With heartfelt gratitude,
T. Graham
Military Spouse & USO Supporter

name: Steve Kerrigan
subject: Election Day is only 6 weeks away, and we need your help
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter-
Today marks six weeks until Election Day, November 5th.
That means we have six weeks left to make the case to the American people that Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have the plans, the knowledge, the empathy, and the drive to work to lead us into the future.
Six weeks to contact as many swing state voters as possible and make sure that they, their families, and their friends have checked their registration status and made a plan to vote on or before November 5th.
Over here at MassDems HQ, we’re all gas, no brakes, 100% of the time, and we need that same commitment from you. Massachusetts Democrats have reached more swing state voters than Democrats from any other state. We have to keep up this incredible work to get Kamala and Tim over the finish line.
Many Massachusetts Democrats have already answered the call to commit some of their time and energy to the Harris/Walz ticket over the next six weeks, but we need to make sure we’re asking as many folks as possible to consider knocking doors, making phone calls, sending texts, or writing postcards.
Will you join us in this work?
We have countless opportunities available for you, straight from Harris/Walz Massachusetts State Director Alex Bausch:
Join Senator Ed Markey, the MassDems Youth Outreach Subcommittee, and more to canvass in Nashua, NH! [https://www.mobilize.us/massdems/event/698129/]
Host a Vice Presidential Debate Watch Party for Gov. Walz! [https://events.democrats.org/c/host-vp-debate-party/event/create/?utm_source=Massachussets&utm_medium=Mobilize&utm_campaign=VP%20Debate]

Six weeks to go, team. Let’s do this.
Onward,

I’m writing to you all today in support of my good friend Lisa Blunt Rochester, the Congresswoman from Delaware. Here are three good reasons why [**_you should support Lisa and her historic campaign for the U.S. Senate._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93447739/500548794/-843060894?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.09.24_Giffords_B1_F1_S1_C1_30OP_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWQ2ZmFhYy03OTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CiHetwBtvMtSbjJ5Z8vj-nhX4HulwqEbXc3hRJ6jLeY=)

I know she’ll do the same in the Senate.

2. **Delaware is one of the key states that will determine if Democrats hold onto their 51-49 Senate majority.** Our Senate majority passed the first comprehensive gun safety law in nearly thirty years in 2022, but to continue building on this progress, we need champions like Lisa to hold the line in 2024. Her self-funding opponent is writing blank checks to their campaign and is relying on outside donors to help flip this seat red.

3. **If elected in November, Lisa would be the _*fourth*_ Black woman to ever serve in the United States Senate.** But Lisa faces an uphill battle with her fundraising numbers. Historically, Black women raise **only one-third** of what their white counterparts raise.

The bottom line is this: National Republicans see people like Lisa, a true leader who stands up the gun lobby and senseless violence, as a threat. And it’s become pretty clear that they’ll do just about anything to defeat her – but we can’t let them. [**_With over a month left until Election Day, Lisa Blunt Rochester needs our help now more than ever. subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/24/2024
body:
Prop. 130 will create $1 million death benefit for emergency responders
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, September 24, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Prop. 130 will create $1 million death benefit for emergency responders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
When there’s an emergency — a home break-in, fire or heart attack — Coloradans depend upon emergency responders from the far stretches of the Eastern Plains to the Western Slope and places in between to be there.
Advance Colorado is asking voters this November to be there for emergency responders. Election Day is Nov. 5.
“Let’s take care of our first responders who take care of us, and make sure their families get a $1 million death benefit,” said Advance Colorado Executive Vice President Kristi Burton Brown on Monday in a Twitter/X post.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Amendment H ensures accountability in Colorado’s judiciary, retired Chief Judge Maes says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Retired Judge Dennis Maes advocates for judicial reform, inspired by investigative reporting on scandals like the Mindy Masias case, leading to his support for Amendment H which proposes independent oversight of judicial discipline.
* Amendment H is driven by concerns over transparency and accountability within Colorado's judicial system, highlighted by insufficient responses to complaints about judicial misconduct and non-compliance in financial disclosures.
* Maes criticizes the internal disciplinary processes, noting their ineffectiveness in addressing serious ethical breaches and conflicts of interest, as demonstrated by the handling of Chief Justice Brian Boatright’s premature comments on ongoing investigations.
* The proposal for Amendment H aims to restore public trust by creating an external body to oversee and discipline judges, ensuring they are subject to the same standards as other public officials.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[First gentleman Marlon Reis sought to ‘craft legislation’ related to wolves, emails show](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado First Gentleman Marlon Reis used his position to influence wolf-related legislation, expressing urgency in emails to secure changes before Governor Jared Polis leaves office.
* Reis engaged with external wildlife activists and a governor's adviser to strategize on passing new laws to protect aspects of the wolf reintroduction plan from potential opposition attacks.
* The emails suggest Reis's involvement in policy making was aimed at crafting legislation that would impose stricter regulations on hunting wolves, demonstrating a proactive approach to legislative change.
* Local officials and some constituents expressed concern over Reis's involvement, perceiving it as government overreach affecting rural lifestyles and traditional practices.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Candidates for Colorado Board of Education agree state falls short in education funding, teacher pay](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado State Board of Education candidates unanimously agree that public education funding and teacher pay are insufficient in the state.
* Despite recent legislative efforts to eliminate budget cuts and increase funding, candidates argue that the adjustments are not enough when considering inflation and current needs.
* Concerns are raised about high administrative costs and inefficient spending, with suggestions to redirect funds directly to classrooms. Candidates highlight the need for ongoing legislative action to address the structural issues within the state’s education funding system.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[King Soopers shooter Ahmad Al Aliwi Alissa found guilty of murdering 10 in Boulder](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Ahmad Al Aliwi Alissa was convicted of first-degree murder for killing 10 people at a Boulder grocery store in 2021, alongside 38 counts of attempted murder and other charges.
* Jurors ruled Alissa was legally sane during the attack, leading to his conviction despite his insanity plea.
* Alissa received a life sentence without parole for each murder count, following a trial delayed by assessments of his mental competency.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Ryan Routh admits to ‘assassination attempt’ in purported letter released by DOJ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Ryan Wesley Routh, 58, was arrested after an alleged assassination attempt on former President Donald Trump on September 14, 2024, in Palm Beach, having left a note admitting to the attempt and expressing regret at his failure.
* The note, left in a box given to an unnamed individual, stated, “This was an assassination attempt on Donald Trump but I failed you...I tried my best and gave it all the gumption I could muster,” and offered $150,000 to anyone who could "complete the job."
* Routh, a convicted felon prohibited from owning firearms, was found in possession of an SKS rifle with an obliterated serial number near Trump’s golf course, leading to charges of possession of a firearm by a convicted felon and possession of a firearm with an obliterated serial number.
* The arrest and subsequent charges focus primarily on his illegal possession of firearms as the investigation continues.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Social media erupts after President throws to Jill Biden to speak at Cabinet meeting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* First Lady Jill Biden's participation in a Cabinet meeting to discuss women's health initiatives sparked controversy and criticism on social media, with many questioning her influence within the Biden administration.
* Critics, including political commentators and former advisors, questioned the appropriateness of her prominent role at the meeting, drawing historical comparisons to influential first ladies.
* The White House defended her involvement, emphasizing the significance of her presentation on women’s health research and criticizing the focus on conspiracy theories by opponents.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Sloan: Paging Hezbollah... the Israelis storied no-nonsense history with terrorists](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Say what you will about the Israelis, no one can accuse them of lacking a degree of chutzpah when they put their minds to dealing with terrorism._
_Last week’s pager and walkie-talkie detonations in the hands and waistbands of thousands of Hezbollah operatives, and the subsequent massive airstrike against the organization (timed perfectly, by the way, to take place in the middle of Hezbollah’s press conference howling about the outrage of the operation – nice touch) read like something out of James Bond or a Tom Clancy novel._
_It was brilliant too: the psychological impact was almost as valuable as the crippling of their communications, and denying an enemy the ability to coordinate movements, relay information, and report to command is priceless in warfare._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Devotional: What is the trunk of who you are?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 23** _Living in the grandness of Colorado and traveling to the mountains often is like walking through a divine art gallery. Nature here doesn’t just sit still; it grabs you by the senses and shakes you awake._
**[Ballot-box biology is once again before Colorado voters in November with Prop. 127](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY LINDY BROWNING | STATE | SEPTEMBER 20** _Although Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) does not take a position on Proposition 127, all it takes is a cursory look at their website to see that Prop. 127 is in direct conflict with science based and biologists’ expertise in mountain lion and bobcat management efforts for a healthy and robust population in Colorado._
**_[Crank earns endorsement of Donald Trump in southern Colorado’s 5th District race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | SEPTEMBER 20** _Jeff Crank, the Republican nominee in Colorado’s 5th District in the U.S. House, has received the coveted endorsement of former President Donald J. Trump._

When it comes to our movement to end gun violence, we believe in hope over fear.
#

Hi there, we don’t want to take up too much of your time today, but we need to ask:
[**Will you make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today, of $3 or any amount that makes sense for you?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240924-1-60&t=1&akid=8997%2E3935704%2Eky1uyl)

When it comes to our movement to end gun violence, we believe in hope over fear.
The hope of a future where our children are safe at school.
The hope of a future where we can go about freely without the threat of gunfire in our public spaces.
The hope of a future where nobody in America—no matter where they live, what they look like, or who they love—has to live with the fear of being a victim of gun violence.
As Gabby always says, the fights worth having are rarely easy. And we all know that the progress we’ve made so far in the gun safety movement has been hard won. We have experienced heartbreak as we’ve mourned tens of thousands of innocent lives lost from gun violence. But we’ve also celebrated the triumphs with the passage of new lifesaving legislation at both the federal level and in states nationwide.
In just 42 days, we have the opportunity to expand upon our progress by maintaining our slim gun safety Senate majority, taking back the House of Representatives, and electing Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz as the next President and Vice President of the United States.
**_It’s our greatest hope that when we wake up on November 6th, all three of these things are a reality._**
[**If you share this same hope for the future of our nation, will you make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC? | | As September draws to a close, I want to take a moment to update you on the important work we've been doing on behalf of Upstate New York.

This month has been filled with both challenges and opportunities, and through it all, my focus has remained on delivering real solutions that impact our communities. Whether it's advocating for local businesses, pushing for common-sense policies, or fighting for the needs of our families, my commitment to serving you never wavers.

**[_Help me fight back! Donate today!_](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=306e33ccfc&e=a39a20e5dd)**
---
|
---
|
---
I'm excited to announce that I’ve secured $10.3 million in federal funding for six local airports, including Greater Binghamton and Tri-Cities Airport.

These funds will go towards much-needed upgrades to terminals, aprons, passenger boarding bridges, and runway lighting. Through the FAA's Airport Infrastructure and Improvement Grant programs, we’re investing in the future of our regional airports, improving the passenger experience, and boosting operational efficiency.

This is a big win for our community and our economy.

- [Greater Binghamton Airport to receive $3M in new funding](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=d937bf6ca3&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
I'm proud to announce that I've joined forces with Rep. Doris Matsui to secure vital funding for mental health awareness training, including programs like Mental Health First Aid (MHFA). Mental health affects all of us, our families, friends, and neighbors. That's why we've sent a bipartisan letter to House Appropriations leadership, urging them to match or exceed the Senate Appropriations Committee's funding level for these essential programs. Why is this so important? Programs like MHFA are game-changers in how we approach mental health crises. They equip our first responders, educators, and community members with the skills to: 1\. Recognize the signs and symptoms of mental health and substance use challenges
2\. Provide initial support to individuals experiencing these issues
3\. Guide people towards appropriate professional help The impact of MHFA is already impressive – over 3 million people across the United States have been trained in this evidence-based, early-intervention program. But we can do more. With proper funding, we can expand this vital training and continue to improve crisis response across New York and the nation. As your representative, I'm committed to fighting for the mental health and well-being of all New Yorkers. This effort is just one step in our ongoing work to create a more supportive, understanding, and healthier community for everyone. [\- National Council Statement Applauding Reps. Matsui and Molinaro for Bipartisan Support of Mental Health Training in 2025 Budget](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=bc28828135&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
|
---
The opioid crisis continues to devastate families and communities across Upstate New York, and addressing this epidemic remains one of my top priorities. In September, I took significant steps forward by joining forces with the Bipartisan Opioid Task Force, where we are focused on bringing real solutions to this growing problem. In our district alone, opioid addiction has torn apart families, contributed to rising overdose rates, and placed tremendous strain on our healthcare systems. We can’t stand by while more lives are lost.

The fight against the opioid crisis is personal for many of us, and it’s going to take all of us working together to turn the tide. We need to continue raising awareness, increasing treatment options, and holding those responsible for trafficking and overprescribing opioids accountable. Together, we can save lives and begin to heal our communities.

[\- Molinaro bill would send funds ](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=6f10f06f88&e=a39a20e5dd)[seized from drug trafficking to addiction services](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=be2d14d5b5&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
|
---
I had the privilege of recognizing our local Vietnam veterans with a heartfelt pinning ceremony in Broome County.

These brave men and women sacrificed so much in service to our country, and it’s important that we continue to honor their commitment and bravery. The Vietnam War was a difficult chapter in our history, and too often, these veterans returned home without the recognition they deserved.

This ceremony was a small gesture to thank them for their courage, dedication, and service. It was truly humbling to stand alongside these heroes and hear their stories, reminding us all of the profound impact they’ve had on our nation.

She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:

Dear Peter,
On September 6, Georgia House Democrats held a press conference and "Day of Action" at the state capitol to urge Governor Brian Kemp to convene a special legislative session focused on gun violence, aiming to raise awareness about gun safety and advocate for stronger measures to protect our children and communities.
This past Thursday, roughly 20 inspiring students – ranging from just five to twelve years old – arrived at a State Senate meeting to exercise their rights to peacefully protest against gun violence, demanding the much-needed legislative action that House Democrats have been fighting for.
And on Friday, hundreds of Georgia students – of all ages and from all corners of our beloved state – walked out of class, adding their voices to the majority of Georgians who are urgently calling for common-sense gun reforms.
All three of these events were prompted by the tragic loss of life at Apalachee High School in Barrow County on September 4.
In the wake of this school tragedy, House Democrats, along with Georgians across the entirety of our state, are saying that the time for meaningful legislative action is now. If you agree, please add your name to the growing list of Georgians calling on Gov. Kemp to finally convene this special session because our children can no longer wait.
SIGN THE PETITION NOW [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gAYtDd2Y0kWxgOzafUyclw2]
[Image of Gun Violence Press Conference]
September 6, 2024 | “Day of Action”
As we mourn the tragic loss of Christian Angulo, Richard Aspinwall, Cristina Irimie, and Mason Schermerhorn, and stand in solidarity with those injured during this heartbreaking event, we must honor their memories through meaningful action. It is imperative that we advocate for change to ensure that such tragedies do not happen again, committing ourselves to promoting safety and preventing future violence in our communities.
Gun violence has tragically become the leading cause of death for children and teenagers in our country, with Georgia's gun death rate 5.5 points higher than the national average*. As leaders in our state, we have a moral and ethical responsibility to confront this alarming epidemic by enacting common-sense gun safety legislation. Supporting measures like The Pediatric Safe Storage Act (HB 971) is essential to protect our students, teachers, and communities from senseless violence and ensure a safer future for all.
If you agree, please take a moment to sign this petition calling on Governor Kemp to convene a special session focused on this urgent issue of gun violence in our schools. On behalf of every citizen in Georgia we need to work together to protect our communities. Our children’s safety can no longer be postponed.
ADD YOUR VOICE [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gAYtDd2Y0kWxgOzafUyclw2]
Now is the time to share our dedication to keeping Georgians safe, and to show our support for life-saving, common-sense gun reforms. Will you join us in asking for this for our children?
Gratefully,
GA House Dems
*Statistic taken from Everytown Research & Policy, 2024 Everytown Gun Law Rankings.

Why I’m running

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457575/500577346/-849459103?refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=&emci=423f986e-af79-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=46764483)
---
My name is Gloria Johnson. I’m a former teacher & state legislator running for Senate against MAGA Marsha Blackburn here in Tennessee. But you probably already knew that. And you probably already know how important my last filing deadline before the election is. **Here’s the deal – I don’t ask for your hard-earned dollar lightly. I know that you choose to invest in movements you care about – and that’s why it’s deeply important to me that you know who I am and why I’m in this race.** **_[So please, take a minute to read my note below, and then I _really_ do need you to chip in before Monday’s end-of-quarter deadline >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457576/500577353/262945212?refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=)_** I’m in this race because _Tennesseans deserve better._ That was made crystal clear earlier last year, in the wake of the horrific Nashville school shooting. Thousands of Tennesseans descended on the state Capitol to demand action on gun violence prevention, but the GOP majority refused to give them a voice. So two of my colleagues and I stood up to join their historic protest. I knew it was against the rules. I knew it’d piss the GOP leadership off. _But I couldn’t let the Covenant families, young people, and parents from across the state stand alone._ The Republican majority took quick action, but not on gun violence. Both my colleagues, Representatives Justin Pearson and Justin Jones, were expelled. _I was spared by a single vote. Then the GOP majority passed a new law to _increase_ access to guns._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457577/500577360/262945212?refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=)
_Photo by Ray di Pietro_ **MAGA Republicans in Nashville and Washington don’t give a damn about us.** They don’t give a damn about using power to save lives or help the people who elected them into office. They only care about their big campaign donors and special interest lobbyists. _But one thing has changed – the people are on our side, and they are standing up to demand action and make the change we need. There’s a movement afoot in Tennessee._ We want action on gun violence prevention. We demand politicians respect our reproductive freedom. And we WILL fight for working families. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457578/500577367/262945212?refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=)
_Photo by Ray di Pietro_ **I’m standing up to take on Senator Marsha Blackburn now because Tennessee deserves better.** Period. But defeating Marsha Blackburn won’t be easy. She’s bankrolled by special interests and deep-pocketed donors – and has spent YEARS building a war chest to protect her seat in the Senate. **_[Hitting my $350,000 goal is critical to harness the energy we’re seeing on the ground and translate that into a massive showing at the ballot box in November. But right now, we’re falling short with only 6 days left to turn things around. I urgently need you with me before my end-of-quarter deadline. Please rush a donation right now, and let’s take on Marsha, the TN GOP, and all their B.S.>>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457579/500577368/262945212?refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=)_** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457580/500577369/262945212?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=) | [**DONATE $10**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93457581/500577370/262945212?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.7f885a83-817a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Zjg4NWE4My04MTdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PYIoDnibRWEcdJapmg_WYZqELhmeEqnDsviZLku1CZQ=)

# _6 Weeks left..._ TIME TO GET MOTIVATED!
---
| **“WHEN WE FIGHT, WE WIN!”****-KAMALA HARRIS****“DO SOMETHING!”****-MICHELLE OBAMA****“WE’RE IN IT TO WIN IT!”****-CARMELA CONROY**
**The numbers don’t lie. We know we can win this.
WE MUST WORK TOGETHER.**
**Now and until November 5th, this volunteer newsletter will serve as your convenient weekly CALL TO ACTION.**
**Check your inbox every Tuesday to be updated on the various ways you can be involved in the TEAM EFFORT to bring common sense leadership to Washington’s 5th District!**
---
[](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=e20d86f360&e=a7b299e420)

****[**DOORBELLING KICKOFF: SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 28th**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=69cf4dadb2&e=a7b299e420) Join us at the Parking lot north of Jefferson Elementary, near Hart field from 10:00-12:00Say hello to Carmela... Pick up a campaign t-shirt... Get trained... Eat a donut!
Please don’t be intimidated—this will be fun and you won’t be alone.

---
|
# Upcoming Events
---
| **American Association of University Women
WA05 Candidates Forum****Walla Walla: Whitman College, Cordiner Hall****Tuesday 9/24 | 5:30-7:00 PM** Candidates for the 5th Congressional District Representative seat will answer questions at Cordiner Hall on the Whitman College campus. Simultaneous interpretation in Spanish will be provided.
[**More information about this event can be found here!**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=aa3984d7d2&e=a7b299e420)[**Stream the event live or watch at a later date!** ](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=195e8e1701&e=a7b299e420)*Allow 48 hours for processing
**Kendall Yards Community Party****Spokane: Kendall Yards, Welcome Center** 1335 West Summit Parkway, Spokane, WA 99201**Wednesday 9/25 | 6:00- 8:00 PM** Chat with Carmela and connect with fellow supporters at the Kendall Yards Welcome Center![**Click here to request an invitation!**](mailto:donorrelations@conroy4congress.com?subject=I'd%20like%20an%20invitation%20to%20the%20Kendall%20Yards%20House%20Party!&body=I'd%20like%20an%20invitation%20to%20the%20Kendall%20Yards%20House%20Party.%20)
**Colville 4th Fridays****Colville: Heritage Court** 117 W Astor Ave, Colville, WA 99114**Friday 9/27 | 5:00 - 7:00 PM** Join Carmela in Colville’s Historic downtown for Septembers 4th Fridays Art Walk and Vendor Fair! Carmela will be around from 5:00-7:00 PM, event runs from 3:00-8:00 PM. [**More information about this event can be found here!**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=076415528c&e=a7b299e420)
**Pullman Listening Tour****Pullman: Various Locations****Sunday 9/29 | ALL DAY** Carmela will be spending the day in Pullman, WA, to meet voters and learn about the issues that matter to them. We hope you can join her at one of these great locations.
* **Pups and Cups 10:00 to 11:30 AM** 250 E. Main St. *Use back door entrance in alley across from library.
* **Terracotta 12:30-2:00 PM** 107 S. Grand Ave.
* **Ridgepoint Retirement Community 2:30 to 4:00** 1402 SE Fancy Free, Clubhouse across from the hospital*Please [**RSVP**](mailto:palouseareademocrats@gmail.com?subject=RSVP%3A%20Ridgepoint%20Retirement%20Community&body=Hi%20Deb%2C%0A%0AI'd%20like%20to%20attend%20the%20Conroy%20event%20at%20Ridgepoint%20if%20parking%20is%20still%20available.%20%0A%0AThanks!) to this event no later than 9/27 to make sure parking is available
* **Rico’s Pub 5:00 to 7:00 PM** 200 E. Main St. *Use back door through alley to the right, across from library.

**Rotary 21 Debate****Streamed Online****Thursday 10/3 | Noon** Streaming info coming soon!**
Spokesman Review Debate****Spokane: Gonzaga University****Tuesday, 10/9 | 5:00-6:30 PM** Tickets to attend this event will be FREE. The debate will also be streamed and rebroadcast that evening on KSPS. Stay tuned for more information!
**Spokane Reddit “Ask Me Anything”****Virtual Event****Friday, 10/11 | 12:00-1:00 PM** This is certain to be an exciting hour for voters on Reddit to learn more about Carmela’s stance on important issues. [**Click here to access the Reddit board where this event will occur.**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=88f21bb6e9&e=a7b299e420)

name: Power the Polls
subject: [Action Required ✅] Have you completed your poll worker application?
body:
| You must complete an official application through your local election administrator’s office. _You’re receiving this email because you have expressed interest in the past about applying to be a poll worker in your community. Power the Polls is here to help connect people to their local elections offices. If you no longer wish to receive emails from Power the Polls,[_you can safely unsubscribe here_](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=8612.934366.FSrup-&t=1&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-)._
# [](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/42?t=2&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-)
1. Getting paid.
2. Taking action for democracy.
3. Seeing our elections in action.

These are just a few of the reasons people love their experience serving as poll workers. And with big elections happening this year, your local election administrators are counting on you. As a reminder, you _must_ complete an official application with your local elections office to be considered for poll worker duty. [**_It only takes a few minutes and you just have to enter your ZIP code to get started._**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4707?t=3&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-) **Peter, have you completed your application yet?** [Not yet. I’ll do it now.](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4707?t=4&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-)** [Yes, I completed my application.](https://act.powerthepolls.org/survey/2024_poll_worker_status_survey_step_1?t=5&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-)** _(If yes,[**_please answer a few questions_**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/survey/2024_poll_worker_status_survey_step_1?t=6&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-) about your poll worker status.)_ Your application will put you in a pool of prospective poll workers that your local election administrators can call upon for upcoming elections. If you submit an application and don’t hear from your election administrator, don’t worry – they’ll keep your name on a backup list in case they need additional help. Thank you for taking this important step to becoming a poll worker!
Marta Hanson (she/her)
National Program Manager
Power the Polls P.S. Your local jurisdiction might call poll workers something different – like “election workers” or “election judges” – but no matter the name, the need for temporary employees to help elections run smoothly is real!
---
* * *
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). You received this message because you are subscribed to Power the Polls' mailing list. [Click here to unsubscribe.](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?ak_proof=1&akid=8612.934366.FSrup-&t=7&akid=8612%2E934366%2EFSrup-) If you have any questions, please contact us at [info@powerthepolls.org](mailto:info@powerthepolls.org) and a member of our team will be in touch.

body:
This should be a no-brainer... but with American gun culture buying into gun manufacturers' desire to play on our fears, some people still think it's OK to bring a deadly weapon with them to vote.
Add your name right now to demand that Congress acts to ensure that we have gun-free zones at our polling places and a place to exercise our democratic rights without fear of violence >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092424_1&amount=25]
Folks --
It’s time to ban guns from every polling place in America.
The voting booth should be a sanctuary of democracy. But every election year, we see reports of extremists openly carrying weapons as voters go to the polls – turning what should be a safe and welcoming experience into one of intimidation and fear.
That's why we're taking bold action to protect voters. Just this year, democracy activists like you helped pass laws restricting guns at polling places in New Mexico and Massachusetts – and with your action, we can bring this solution to every state in the nation.
Sign our petition to tell Congress: No guns at the polls! >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
With political tensions running high, it's more important than ever to ensure our polling places remain free from suppression and fear. No matter what you think about gun safety laws, banning guns at the polls is a commonsense step that every American who loves democracy should be able to agree on right now.
Our democracy works best when every voter feels safe and empowered. Voting is meant to be an act of hope – NOT fear – and with your help, we can make that a reality nationwide.
It’s time -- add your name to our petition today telling Congress to make every polling place a gun-free zone >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

subject: Mary Kay Costello
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
President Biden has appointed twelve LGBTQ+ federal judges so far.
#
**Derek, we just broke an important record in the Senate.**
We confirmed Mary Kay Costello, the twelfth LGBTQ+ federal judge appointed by President Biden – officially the most LGBTQ+ court appointments of any president in U.S. history! 🏳️🌈
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240924?refcode=em20240924-9413&refcode2=9413_434096_jIMrkn&akid=9413%2E434096%2EjIMrkn)
**[Here’s some even better news: You can help us keep up this momentum by keeping the White House🔵 and defending our Senate majority. Will you give a $5 contribution right now to make sure Democrats win this November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240924?refcode=em20240924-9413&refcode2=9413_434096_jIMrkn&akid=9413%2E434096%2EjIMrkn)**
Judge Costello has served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Philadelphia for the past fifteen years. Her qualifications, experience, and expertise make her a natural fit to serve as a U.S. District Court Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.
Judge Costello and all of the LGBTQ+ judges we’ve confirmed under President Biden’s leadership represent a major step forward for diversity in our courts. 🏛️
**It’s not rocket science, Derek: Judges should reflect the diverse makeup of the communities they serve.** Judges should come from every background, race, gender, orientation, and identity. It’s the best way to ensure fair and just decisions.
For too long, though, our federal courts have lacked significant diversity for many groups, including the LGBTQ+ community. President Biden and Senate Democrats are bound and determined to change that – and we’re making history as we do it.
But – a majority of Senate Republicans voted no on Judge Costello’s confirmation. _Only a handful_ crossed the aisle to support this talented, qualified, LGBTQ+ judge.
That really says it all, doesn’t it? It’s sad, but true: **We will only continue to make this kind of history next year with a Democratic president and a 🔵 Senate.**
**[Derek, I know you’re with us in the fight to make progress for the LGBTQ+ community and diversify our federal courts. But the GOP is ready to roll back and halt our progress if they take the reins. Please – pitch in $5 now to stop the GOP in their tracks!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240924?refcode=em20240924-9413&refcode2=9413_434096_jIMrkn&akid=9413%2E434096%2EjIMrkn)**

Thanks,
❤️ John

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

Friends,
On Long Island, it’s easy to understand people.
Have a conversation with them, look them in the eye, and listen. And you know what we value most?
When you give someone your word - you better keep your promise.
When you say you’ll do things like fight for affordability, women’s rights, and a secure border - people pay attention.
And here in Suffolk County, we hold you to it.
So when you don’t keep your word? Watch out.
That’s the message folks across the district are waking up to today on TV. Nick LaLota’s broken promises are unforgivable:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-promises?refcode=em09 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-promises?refcode=em09]
We have 6 weeks to go until Election Day. Every single voter needs to see this message. We’re up on cable TV right now, but we need your help to sustain our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-promises?refcode=em09]
When I’m in Congress, I’ll keep my promises. I’ll fight to stop a national abortion ban. I’ll help pass a bipartisan border security bill. And I’ll work to restore the state and local tax deduction - putting an average of $10,000 back in your pocket every year.
That’s what keeping your promises looks like. And it’s why I’m honored to be running to bring common sense to Congress.
Help us spread the word with just 6 weeks to go >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-promises?refcode=em09]
Thank you for fighting the good fight with me.
- John

| Last week, in over 100 cities across the nation, Vaxxed III: Authorized to Kill, the third chapter in the groundbreaking Vaxxed franchise, premiered. TFVC was again honored to lock arms with Children’s Health Defense to co-host and welcome guests at the Texas locations. On Wednesday night, theaters in Abilene, Fort Worth, Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Austin began to fill with curious moviegoers.
As you may recall, TFVC also coordinated all of the stops the bus made in Texas last year and into the beginning of this year. On this tour, CHD was determined to document the egregious stories of the COVID response. At the Texas stops, individuals made the daunting trip up the steps into the bus and behind Polly Tommey’s camera to tell their painful stories.
**It was these stories that were beautifully and horrifyingly told in the movie.**
We may never know the full scope of all of the corruption and tyranny behind the global COVID response, but this movie that documents the stories of loved ones who were injured or died due to an adverse reaction to an experimental COVID shot or died alone in a hospital bed deprived of life-saving care due to hospital protocols is a vital first step.
The agonizing stories paint the picture of how governments at all levels colluded to rob us of a piece of our humanity. We must all remain vigilant to ensure that this callous disregard never returns to our shores.
_If you missed the in-person premiere of Vaxxed III, you can watch it online for free beginning Friday, October 4._

subject: Kamala's 'womanhood' paradox
body:
Op-ed by Beth Anna Rosica | B+L Featured Columnist | | | |
---
| | |
---
| _**_Beth Ann Rosica:_ The case against Kamala — Part Three**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b0aab464d4&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| While Kamala Harris has dubbed herself the champion of women’s reproductive rights, she has stripped away protections and equal opportunities for women and girls with the rewrite of Title IX. Part three of this series focuses on Harris’s antithetical positions on Title IX and abortion, and how her policies really do not support women.

The Biden-Harris administration and members of their political party literally cannot or refuse to define the term “woman.” Yet when it comes to abortion, remarkably, Harris seems to understand that only women are capable of getting pregnant and carrying a baby. Her campaign website says, “Vice President Harris and Governor Walz trust women to make decisions about their own bodies, and not have the government tell them what to do...”
---
| [Read More](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8ec887670b&e=b7b3eddce2 "Read More")
---
|
---
| ****Special Event, THIS Wednesday, Sept. 25th****
---
| This Wednesday, _Broad + Liberty_ CEO Terry Tracy will moderate a panel discussion on Pennsylvania’s economic future hosted by [Level Up](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e688774b29&e=b7b3eddce2) and the Chester County Chamber of Commerce, where he will be joined by U.S. Senate candidate Dave McCormick and Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders.

Level Up invests in the growth and empowerment of center-right women entrepreneurs, business and public service leaders, and the next generation of women poised to ascend. Level Up believes advocacy for equipped, courageous women are a transformative force for good. Learn more about the organization [here](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f6b471f548&e=b7b3eddce2).

While this event is now sold out, please stay tuned for similar programming opportunities in the near future. For those already registered for the event, we look forward to seeing you there!

| |

Beth Ann Rosica holds a Ph.D. in Education and has dedicated her career to advocating on behalf of at-risk children and families. She became politically active during the extended school closures, speaking out about the detrimental effects on children. Beth Ann led the local grassroots movement to open schools and eliminate mandatory masks while assisting school board candidates across the state and country with their campaigns. She has a consulting business and covers education issues for _Broad + Liberty_. Beth Ann resides in West Chester, PA with her husband and two teenage sons.

Trump came to Arizona twice in less than a month. His first rally after that disaster of a debate was here, in Tucson. And he attacked me directly both times he was here.
#

I want to avoid giving this too much attention, Peter.
But Trump came to Arizona twice in less than a month. His first rally after that disaster of a debate was here, in Tucson. And he attacked me directly both times he was here.
He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run."
But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. Those are his own words, Peter. He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November.
He’s worried. And I’ve got a message for him: **Show some respect.**

Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo opt.

But that's not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6'4" man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it 's not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

| UPCOMING ELECTION DEADLINES
---
|
# JUST THE FACTS
---
|
# THE HONEY BADGER REPORT
---
|
# THE QUESTION ON THE BALLOT THIS YEAR
---
|
Dear Friends & Supporters,
There is a question on the ballot that you may not be expecting. This is a proposed Constitutional Amendment that asks:
"Should the Constitution of Virginia be amended so that the tax exemption that is currently available to the surviving spouses of soldiers killed in action is also available to the surviving spouses of soldiers who died in the line of duty?"
The ballot measure would amend [Article X, Section 6-A](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RxIB6KHJpjbrBRfGUidTyDtjKUE21gJ4ELSeMUefgCmkiyqYsnA81HUvADs_9T7gOpBZMsr6AHWubqMpItGEoxVe4KhqtqJhulrhqTaVCA72kUQRMdMm40KosqOTt7skqou3E_bxzvIG70JpqRYo3TYmApwBLXSWJqcHyLG864WGhuBPVNv2KaQdgAxK92QxmucM85AD3GFn6mwfJYhASw==&c=kTVnNDzCTVI9GixvIeEyQSCD8-3bGtk0JMJzbFC0D17ze0XuDCYe9w==&ch=lRVLt-pCtViAsL_penGysL3RuheRy_Qm9rNC4Zxz-bbSut3MJROTEQ==) of the [Virginia Constitution](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RxIB6KHJpjbrBRfGUidTyDtjKUE21gJ4ELSeMUefgCmkiyqYsnA81HUvADs_9T7gGGkE7JTZSfg0PmjdaToHenxCDzZV5DUN9JML1TU3grNd8kc58FLXRmrLhucHrX7N6mQHAEuDFYGwLK7P2vTjfz6O1C0ejirE6EqutPWVHD78aG9BOOeVSA==&c=kTVnNDzCTVI9GixvIeEyQSCD8-3bGtk0JMJzbFC0D17ze0XuDCYe9w==&ch=lRVLt-pCtViAsL_penGysL3RuheRy_Qm9rNC4Zxz-bbSut3MJROTEQ==).
This amendment would amend language in the [Virginia Constitution](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RxIB6KHJpjbrBRfGUidTyDtjKUE21gJ4ELSeMUefgCmkiyqYsnA81HUvADs_9T7gGGkE7JTZSfg0PmjdaToHenxCDzZV5DUN9JML1TU3grNd8kc58FLXRmrLhucHrX7N6mQHAEuDFYGwLK7P2vTjfz6O1C0ejirE6EqutPWVHD78aG9BOOeVSA==&c=kTVnNDzCTVI9GixvIeEyQSCD8-3bGtk0JMJzbFC0D17ze0XuDCYe9w==&ch=lRVLt-pCtViAsL_penGysL3RuheRy_Qm9rNC4Zxz-bbSut3MJROTEQ==) regarding property tax exemptions for veterans and surviving spouses to say died in the line of duty rather than killed in action. The line of duty determination would come from the U.S. Department of Defense.
In Virginia, surviving spouses of members of armed forces who were killed in action can apply for a property tax exemption. The determination must be made by the Department of Defense.
The exemption is provided to the principal residence of the surviving spouse. The exemption would not apply to surviving spouses who remarry.
Virginia voters approved the amendment providing for tax exemptions for surviving spouses in 2014.
In Virginia, in order for the state legislature to place a constitutional amendment on the ballot, the amendment must pass both chambers of the state legislature in two consecutive sessions.
The amendment was prefiled to the Virginia State Senate on December 12, 2022 as Senate Joint Resolution 231 (SJR 231).
On February 3, 2023, the Senate unanimously passed SJR 231 by 38-0, and on February 23, 2023, the Virginia House of Representatives unanimously passed the measure by 95-0.
The amendment was prefiled to the second legislative session on November 20, 2023 as Senate Joint Resolution 3 (SJR 3).
On February 5, 2024, the Senate voted unanimously to pass the amendment by 40-0.
On February 21, 2024, the House voted unanimously to pass the amendment by 99-0.
While both the Virginia House and Senate have unanimously approved this Constitutional Amendment, it must now be approved by We The People.
You may vote either yes or no. Ultimately the people will decide whether or not this Constitutional Amendment passes.
The first day of in-person early voting began on Friday, September 20. You can vote at your local registrar's office or other satellite locations in your county. The last of in-person voting is Tuesday, November 5. Click [here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RxIB6KHJpjbrBRfGUidTyDtjKUE21gJ4ELSeMUefgCmkiyqYsnA81H-0WgeHTLBIEstHBPNJn2IvHrW-sTfsmFAySsF4hnp26GOrraidICrAHJhChGXFJUryCROVn7ZW4n0PlgwS-L36ukJQcPFTkQpzouKCsL_vOXgkO3SOPyU=&c=kTVnNDzCTVI9GixvIeEyQSCD8-3bGtk0JMJzbFC0D17ze0XuDCYe9w==&ch=lRVLt-pCtViAsL_penGysL3RuheRy_Qm9rNC4Zxz-bbSut3MJROTEQ==) for more details.
While our primary focus right now is winning this November, some of you will also vote in December and January.
If you live in the following counties, you will most likely vote in November, December and January:
APPOMATTOX AMELIA BUCKINGHAM CUMBERLAND PRINCE EDWARD (part) FLUVANNA GOOCHLAND HENRICO (Shady Grove) HANOVER (Western) LOUISA POWHATAN
Now through November, we will vote for President Donald J Trump, Hung Cao for U.S. Senate & State Senator John McGuire for Congress.
Once our ticket wins, in December and January we will focus on filling the state senate seat that will be vacated by State Senator John McGuire. Please be aware that there will most likely be a Republican Mass Meeting in early December, with a Special Election this coming January 7, 2025 to fill the State Senate Seat currently held by John McGuire.
So many of you will vote in November, December and again in January. The location and exact date will be determined once the Governor calls for the Special Election.
I'm told by Republican leadership that no preparation can be done until Governor Youngkin calls for a Special Election, and then within 5 days the Republican Party will have to have a candidate. So please stay tuned.
I've thrown my hat in the ring to finish Senator John McGuire's State Senate Seat.
We need a senator-elect, who has an 8 year proven voting record that you can trust and will hit the ground running on day one. There will be no time for on the job training for the winner, as the Special Election will probably take place the day before session begins.
I've served in the senate for 8 years from 2016-2023 and I'm ready to put my experience to work for the people of Virginia once again. We need a senator who can hit the ground running on day one.
You can trust my conservative 8 year voting record.
100% Family Foundation 100% Virginia Federation of Independent Business 100% VCDL A rating NRA
I'm ready to serve and I humbly ask for your support. If you live in the district, I ask for your vote.
If you don't live in the district, please donate. You may not be able to vote for me but I can vote for you.
Signs, bumper stickers and yard signs are available at all GOP meetings.
Can't make it to a GOP meeting?Reply to this email and we'll be sure to get them to you.
Please email me back with any questions or comments. I will personally reply.

---
| Massachusetts' Welfare Fraud Exposed: $2.3 Million Wasted and Accountability Needed
---
---
| Boston, MA- In the past quarter alone, investigators uncovered over $2.3 million in welfare fraud across Massachusetts, with at least 176 cases reported between April 1 and June 30. Of these, approximately $1.9 million--nearly 80%--involved food stamp fraud, while $245,858 was Medicaid fraud, and $138,081 came from cash assistance. In previous years, fraud amounted to over $12.3 million in fiscal year 2023 and $13.5 million in FY 2022. This highlights the ongoing mismanagement and reckless spending of taxpayer dollars in Massachusetts.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on the recent welfare fraud reported for the past quarter of FY 2024, stating, "$2.3 million in taxpayer money fraudulently spent in just one quarter is unacceptable. The lack of accountability in handling taxpayer dollars is egregious. Residents should be outraged that their money is being so poorly managed, with little oversight of these programs. To Democrats, it seems this is simply the cost of doing business. They must show greater respect for residents' hard-earned money, and stronger oversight is needed to ensure responsible spending."
"The Democratic supermajority has repeatedly proven they are incapable of managing taxpayer dollars. When they overspend and mismanage funds, they simply ask for more. It’s no secret that Mitch McConnell is determined to defeat me. He personally recruited a wealthy out-of-stater to run in this race, and his buddies are spending nearly $90 million to smear my record. I hate to say it,folks, but that spending is working: Polls are tied. Now we have less than three weeks until Montanans start voting. You can bet Mitch McConnell’s buddies will throw everything but the kitchen sink at us to win this race. I’m working to represent rural communities and defend our Montana way of life, but I can’t do it alone. If we want to win this race, then our campaign needs more support—fast. = = Thanks, I really appreciate the support. —Jon Tester | | | Tobias Read is running for Oregon Secretary of State to bring real change to our state. I'm running for Congress because I believe our Texas values are worth fighting for. And it's my honor to usher in a new day for TX-31 with you.
Whenever people tell me they plan to support me, I respond simply: I will keep earning that support.

body:
Get your tickets...and more campaign updates. | | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | |
---
|
# “Paint It Red” dinner is just a week away!
---
| Our special dinner fundraiser with Congresswoman Cathy McMorris Rodgers is little more than one week away.
Spots are filling up - get your ticket [now](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=4c95056fde&e=5a45b9550e)! Contact [anitra@votebaumgartner.com](mailto:anitra@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body=) for more details or to RSVP.
We hope to see you next Wednesday Oct 2 – but if you can’t join us, please still consider donating [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=2b09597185&e=5a45b9550e).

---
[](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=562099bd27&e=5a45b9550e)
|
# Huddling with Republican Leadership in DC
---
| I had a great trip to Washington DC to meet and talk strategy with House Republican leadership.
Spirits were very high with strong polling showing House Republicans keeping the majority and Donald Trump expected to win the White House.
However, there are concerns that Harris replacing Biden has sent the Democrat base’s enthusiasm and fundraising skyrocketing. Currently, Democrat fundraising is outpacing Republicans by a 2 to 1 margin. The bottom line is that a sweeping victory for Republicans is more than possible if Republican donors step up and match the surging Democrats.
---
|
# ...and with Republican Leadership back home
---
| It was great to meet with GOP leadership from the 12 counties that comprise the 5th Congressional District on Saturday.
I’m grateful for the extensive grassroots work of our County Parties across the district and for the PCOs who step forward to run for election and help candidates. I always say that winning in politics is a “team sport” and we certainly have a great team here in Eastern Washington.
Thank you to all the party officials who gave up their time to talk policy and strategy.
---
|
---
|
# On the Trail
---
| Our campaign team was at Odessa Deutschesfest on Saturday, enjoying the fun atmosphere of this annual festival celebrating Odessa’s heritage. We also had a great time joining the Valleyfest festivities in Spokane Valley.
On Sunday I ran with our daughter Victoria in The Boulevard Race in Spokane, a fantastic community event to support cancer patients.
Fun photos from Odessa and the recent Connell Fall Festival below.
---
|
# Letter to the Editor
---
| Our campaign appreciated this letter in the Spokesman at the weekend:
**Baumgartner will prioritize youth health** The most significant issues facing our youth today are crime and drugs, like fentanyl, coming into our country illegally. As a student in college, I have seen how deadly, yet prevalent fentanyl is. ...I believe Baumgartner will work tirelessly to pass measures in Congress that will stop fentanyl, crime, drug cartels, and human trafficking from entering the U.S.He has taken the time to visit our southern border and to learn more about these challenges from our law enforcement, and that gives me confidence that he will work hard to protect our communities and keep drugs from destroying them.Michael Baumgartner will prioritize my generation’s health and safety so we can grow up to live meaningful lives._Andrew Howison, Spokane_ Read [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=8decae8f4d&e=5a45b9550e)
Writing a letter to your local newspaper really helps us to spread the message. If you would like contacts or support, please contact [eleanor@votebaumgartner.com](mailto:eleanor@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body=).
---
| **Upcoming dates**
---
| For those near Walla Walla, join us for the 5CD candidate forum (hosted by AAUW, Walla Walla-Union Bulletin, Walla Walla Chamber of Commerce) **tonight** \- Sep 24 - from 5:30 to 7 p.m. at Cordiner Hall, 46 S. Park St., on the Whitman College campus.
We have several more debates scheduled with my Democrat opponent:
**October 3:** Rotary 21 lunch debate, Spokane**October 8:** Gonzaga University debate (co-hosted by The Spokesman and Spokane Public Television)**October 21:** Foley Institute debate, WSU, Pullman (co-hosted by KHQ)**October 30:** KREM debate, Spokane
Thank you for your support!

Spots are filling up - get your ticket ! Contact mailto:anitra@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body= for more details or to RSVP. We hope to see you next Wednesday Oct 2 – but if you can’t join us, please still consider donating . | Huddling with Republican Leadership in DC | I had a great trip to Washington DC to meet and talk strategy with House Republican leadership. Spirits were very high with strong polling showing House Republicans keeping the majority and Donald Trump expected to win the White House. However, there are concerns that Harris replacing Biden has sent the Democrat base’s enthusiasm and fundraising skyrocketing. Currently, Democrat fundraising is outpacing Republicans by a 2 to 1 margin. The bottom line is that a sweeping victory for Republicans is more than possible if Republican donors step up and match the surging Democrats. | ...and with Republican Leadership back home | It was great to meet with GOP leadership from the 12 counties that comprise the 5th Congressional District on Saturday. I’m grateful for the extensive grassroots work of our County Parties across the district and for the PCOs who step forward to run for election and help candidates. I always say that winning in politics is a “team sport” and we certainly have a great team here in Eastern Washington. Thank you to all the party officials who gave up their time to talk policy and strategy. | | On the Trail | Our campaign team was at Odessa Deutschesfest on Saturday, enjoying the fun atmosphere of this annual festival celebrating Odessa’s heritage. We also had a great time joining the Valleyfest festivities in Spokane Valley. On Sunday I ran with our daughter Victoria in The Boulevard Race in Spokane, a fantastic community event to support cancer patients. Fun photos from Odessa and the recent Connell Fall Festival below. | Letter to the Editor | Our campaign appreciated this letter in the Spokesman at the weekend: Baumgartner will prioritize youth health The most significant issues facing our youth today are crime and drugs, like fentanyl, coming into our country illegally. body:
The legacy media is holding Kamala Harris to a higher standard than Donald Trump.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93481707/500639383/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDgzMDgxMDctOWU3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7QXablQ6221GglCobJ4AS5QKQUScmXhViW9T5Ap2sjU=&emci=06308107-9e7a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=08308107-9e7a-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Yesterday, MSNBC’s Morning Joe aired a devastating takedown of the legacy media for its pro-Trump coverage of the presidential race.
Joe Scarborough highlighted numerous examples, criticizing legacy media outlets like _The New York Times_ and _The Wall Street Journal_ for demanding detailed plans from Kamala Harris while overlooking Donald Trump's incoherence, his fear-mongering about pet-eating in Springfield, and bizarre comments about turning the handle of a giant faucet to help with the water crisis in California.
[**We’ll tell you why we agree with Morning Joe’s takedown in a second, but if you’re ready to support COURIER’s efforts to expose legacy media bias, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93481708/500639384/-593472309?refcode=20240924-EM-MorningJoe&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDgzMDgxMDctOWU3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7QXablQ6221GglCobJ4AS5QKQUScmXhViW9T5Ap2sjU=)
For over a decade, the legacy media's outdated "both sides" reporting model has failed in covering Donald Trump. Trump doesn’t discuss policy – instead, he insults, spreads lies, and, these days, often sounds completely incoherent.
However, under the “both sides” framework, if a news outlet emphasizes these facts, they're accused of being biased against Trump. As a result, instead of delivering the truth, the legacy media constantly seeks ways to balance coverage.
**This often leads to parroting right-wing talking points, like the claim that Kamala Harris is all style and no substance—even though she's presented detailed plans, such as a $25,000 down-payment assistance for first-time homebuyers, $50,000 tax credits for small business startups, and partnerships to create new jobs through private investment.**
So what’s going on?
According to Scarborough, “they’re desperately trying to create the permission structure” to defend Trump, despite his clear flaws and the danger he represents to democracy.
**Here at COURIER, we don’t engage with the false “both sides” argument. Our fearless, factual news focuses on the truth: Trump is dangerous and a threat to our democracy.**
The legacy media’s inability to cover Trump is central to his rise in American politics. We desperately need change, and it’s why COURIER is doing our part to hold the media accountable for their biased reporting.

If you would like to unsubscribe, please visit this [link.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=92ebd5bdecf44b49a78538bab4a4fe3b&_t=VvE0yhfDd-8c32bGmaeWuUGFD4j0mQI2vOtQTWwGncK7XWDEXltakaD3FHOMtyIUOshNJzdba6VvvYCKGO-7fvILwt3Bz0k5IjtjfGJSkelVWIFzQe2KZiFEMDAXv2Px)

Friend, There's a special date for me that lies right in the heart of Hispanic Heritage Month: September 18, the anniversary of my Uncle Angel Miyares escaping communist Cuba.

On Election Night 2015, upon hearing I had won my election to the Virginia House, he exclaimed: _**" Tonight, I feel like I just beat Castro!"**_

Given he had been jailed as a young man by the Castro regime, it remains one of my favorite memories from that night.

The photo below is him as a young man in much happier times out on the town in Havana, before Castro turned that beautiful country into an island prison. The second is from the 2015 election night.
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=92ebd5bdecf44b49a78538bab4a4fe3b&_e=G4E40Wu0IeoExcaZTq5366u3wgOxZIoqAA2kb6B6OujjRA49kepABwLXXtTHHcWXfZAVo0H8-qiiBmXUoZXEyCBu-PFWXymUu9G1f1YeeWkoIVnDklZDiYRkz8s9cS-lu7i9DiMV889rSmTNkrWvWRi4WcfFKm5BPeclppvkD_Z0TciDVPVwDzI5aDc6tPyFPfwGlStRpLPO6SArCWCzMkQABRp92xUGIiPBCj2TqHQV2lOUZULpleK_MUNnYY581F0_XFQ7qkPIgstGFyTvemlpArvlku-QwoMK5ODz9rIaeM4HrVxYsIddvm8NmkpF9K71TNc1B7PqzeF2FZORCZw74rG-xuOaINthCzvnl_hoD7On6UkMvvqqemA7_9mlR5_H8d2ZZMKNFblUBMHyFt5HJLqIiqzH5wdn6x-gl7M%3D)

| | September 18, 1964 is when he gave up everything he had ever known to seek freedom, and for that I am forever grateful for all he has done for me over my life.

When I celebrate my Hispanic heritage, part of that heritage is the knowledge of how fragile freedom can be -- and the great sacrifices we must make to ensure freedom for the next generation.

I owe my historic win as Virginia's first Hispanic Attorney General to my family, who fought to achieve the American Dream. **Their experience living in Fidel Castro 's Communist Cuba is why I will _ALWAYS_ fight to reject socialism.**

As Attorney General, I am honoring my heritage by fighting to ensure the socialism, tyranny, and chaos we fled **do not undermine freedom here in America.**

# _**Your YDA September Newsletter**_
---
We’re just 41 days away from Election Day, and the momentum is building. After the first debate, we watched Kamala Harris take the stage and decisively expose Donald Trump for the fraud he is, proving once again why she’s the leader we need to guide us forward. Alongside Governor Walz, there’s a renewed sense of urgency and hope across our nation. This election is about so much more than speeches or soundbites—it’s about the future of our country and the critical role we all play. As we approach the final weeks, it’s important to stay engaged and informed. This election represents the values we all share, and together, we can keep pushing forward to secure the change we’ve worked so hard for.

_Expanded access to food stamps, health care becomes law in Alaska
_
---
#### [_Alaska Beacon_ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwocQn_N6gxpsi3QNNX4WKz83aLpl6a8FzWPc-6gW3hK9ySd1idd9YAgrqNX_bTzv7VshTRcZT5edNGSvFdT5jJMtPvAK3Ljab7hKE4tdSXab00KYWuMWlsJ6ws3-mM01woRI2jr8AAl__xjyqFNlcDHl7CTwy6Uxzo-kjHpjDD0HNczrT5FPUWHbmQw2JdHIcLQM4akpZxeAlFUb7Sym4a9Pcj6dlWuzwV16MbcSFadDFbaE9_g56kZk9NWCNIrcJ6vej84JojO1DSZH8kKNoWuBdSKw5cmEYjMbO8k0t3YPW4cZbtTfjqgrlC_ebFHUnWpGFbIAejecAw83IaaComfQ4KsuoBRihfn6Hti1hdc-A/4a1/OVpu0u46TueUB_-WeXhnTg/h27/h001.qTQREnL0VefKlDfrsFHrU3_aWmpMfYXR0h1mBojDPOc)-_The law takes advantage of waivers to allow more Alaskans to access federal aid programs_
---
More Alaskans will be eligible for food stamps and access to health care for school-age children and young adults will increase under a bill that became law without Gov. Mike Dunleavy’s signature on Aug. 30.

Dunleavy sponsored the original bill, whose goal was to expand the services covered by Medicaid to include things like workforce development and food security. The bill takes advantage of a a federal waiver that allows states to consider the underlying causes of ill health. It was amended to include a proposal from Rep. Genevieve Mina, D-Anchorage, and Sen. Cathy Giessel, R-Anchorage, aimed at increasing SNAP access after the state’s Department of Health failed to process thousands of applications within the legal timeline in a backlog that left thousands of Alaskans without food aid for months at a time. Over the last two years, Dunleavy’s administration has added more than $70 million to state budgets to fight the crisis.

The state Senate passed the final version of House Bill 344 by a unanimous vote and the bill passed the Alaska House of Representatives by a vote of 26-14 on the final day of the 2024 legislative session.
