clean_body: In September here’s what need to know >>> | | Your YDA September Newsletter We’re just 41 days away from Election Day, and the momentum is building. After the first debate, we watched Kamala Harris take the stage and decisively expose Donald Trump for the fraud he is, proving once again why she’s the leader we need to guide us forward. Alongside Governor Walz, there’s a renewed sense of urgency and hope across our nation. This election is about so much more than speeches or soundbites—it’s about the future of our country and the critical role we all play. As we approach the final weeks, it’s important to stay engaged and informed. This election represents the values we all share, and together, we can keep pushing forward to secure the change we’ve worked so hard for. | Upcoming Events \- Sep 26 - Virtual \- Sep 29 - Virtual Vice Presidential Debate - Oct 1 - New York City, NY\- Oct 1 - Boston, MA \- Oct 3 - Trenton, NJ \- Oct 3 - Taylor, TX \- Oct 3 - Taylor, TX \- Oct 5 - Mt. Vernon, WA \- Oct 5 - Southern Tier, NY \- Oct 5 - Farmville, VA \- Oct 6 - Bowling Green, KY \- Oct 6 - Lockhart, FL \- Oct 10 - Glassboro, NJ \- Oct 11-13 - Springdale, AR \- Oct 16 - Albany, NY \- Oct 17 - Reno, NV \- Oct 19 - Philadelphia, PA Is there a YDA local, chartered unit or caucus event that should be listed in our next newsletter? Email us atmailto:office@yda.org to let us know. | Share Your Photos & Content with YDA Do you have photos of events you or your chapter have hosted? Here at YDA, we love to highlight and celebrate our chapters. Please DM us photos of the exciting things your chapter has been up to. Photos can be submitted by messaging @theyoungdemocrats on Instagram You can also DM us on twitter (@YoungDems) with posts or content you want us to share or boost. Always feel free to email us at mailto:communications@yda.org with any questions or concerns. | Save the Date: YDA Winter Meeting — December 6-8 | The Young Democrats of America will gather for an exciting Winter Meeting from December 6-8 in Boston, Massachusetts. This in-person event will bring together young leaders from across the nation to participate in impactful committees, dynamic constituency caucuses, hands-on trainings, and more. As we convene in the historic and vibrant heart of New England, YDA members will have the chance to connect, collaborate, and continue shaping the future of the Democratic Party. Against the backdrop of Boston’s rich legacy and forward-thinking spirit, we will look back on the 2024 election, reflecting on our successes, challenges, and the road ahead, making this a truly energizing weekend for all in attendance. Check our website later this month for information on registration and lodging. | YDA 2025 Convention Site: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania | Last month, the Young Democrats of America National Committee held a voted to determine our 2025 National Convention location and we're excited to announce that YDA will be heading to Philadelphia, Pennsylvania next summer. YDA is excited to partner with our friends at the Pennsylvania Young Democrats to create a one of a kind convention right as Philadelphia begins to kickoff the yearlong celebration for America's Semiquincentennial. There will be more information to come about the Convention in early 2025. | Harris for President Campaign Updates | Host a Vice Presidential Debate Watch Party | Circle Oct. 1 on your Calendar! We're all in for the Vice Presidential Debate featuring Gov. Walz taking on JD Vance. Coach Walz has our back and now it's time to have his! This debate will take place just 1 month out from Election Day and will be an excellent opportunity to get your friends, family, and neighbors involved in paving a New Way Forward with VP Harris and Gov. Walz. . | DNC’s National Voter Assistance Hotline Volunteer Opportunity The DNC’s National Voter Assistance Hotline is a year-round resource for voters to get the information they need to cast their ballots, and to direct any issues to our voter protection staff to take action on voter challenges & intimidation. They are seeking volunteers for a fully remote opportunity. They have flexible shifts during the week and soon, on weekends as well. It is a great, flexible opportunity for people with busy schedules who want to be engaged this election. | Young Dems Actions and Events NYSYD Do Something Bus Tour RSVP | Join the New York State Young Democrats on their Do Something Bus Tour as they hold canvassing events across New York and the Tri-State area. . | Chapter Event Highlight: PAYD and NJYD Joint Canvass | | On Saturday, September 21st, the New Jersey Young Democrats and Pennsylvania Young Democrats teamed up for an incredible PAYD & NJYD Joint Day of Action to Get Out the Vote in Pennsylvania. This election season is critical, and it was inspiring to see so many Young Democrats step up for candidates up and down the ballot. Your dedication is what drives our movement forward. Thank you to everyone who joined us, especially the NJ Young Dems who crossed state lines to make a difference. A huge shoutout to NJYD President Fatima Heyward and PAYD President Hans van Mol for this energizing partnership. Additional thanks to Young Democrats of America Eastern Region VP Gabriela Koc and YDA Eastern Region Communications Director Benton for joining us on this fantastic crossover and our efforts on the ground! | NJYD Phone Banking with Sue Altman | Join the New Jersey Young Democrats, College Democrats, and High School Democrats on Zoom to help #FlipNJ7 on alternating Thursdays at 6pm, starting next Thursday, September 12th! They’ll have guest speakers to kick off our calls that will be announced as the date approaches. . | YDA Eastern Region Phonebank with Congresswoman Sara Jacobs | Join us this Sunday, Sept. 29th, from 5 PM to 7 PM for a special collaboration with the Harris-Walz campaign on an Eastern Region phone banking effort! The event will also feature brief remarks from California Congresswoman Sara Jacobs. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to make an impact. . | Young Democrats in the News Young Democrats of North Carolina Statement on Mark Robinson - Following the events on a porn forum with Mark Robinson, candidate for Governor, the Young Democrats of North Carolina have released a statement Mark Robinson has worn his hate for women, Jews, and LGBTQ+ people as a badge of honor for years—but it took him calling himself a “Black Nazi” on message boards to force the NCGOP to face the real Mark Robinson they’d hoped we’d never meet. | Kentucky Young Democrats President says she's been harassed by Louisville Rep. Grossberg in statement on social media \- Allison Wiseman says she is one of the many alleged victims of Rep. Daniel Grossberg who accuse him of harassment. "Ugh, he's creepy, be careful." This is what President of the Young Democrats, Allison Wiseman said she told a friend about Louisville Rep. Daniel Grossberg at an event they attended. In a statement on X, formerly Twitter, Wiseman accuses Grossberg of harassment. She is one of many other alleged victims accusing the state representative. Wiseman reached out to WHAS11 and gave express permission to publish her statements. | What Rhode Island’s Young Democrats thought about the presidential debate - Weeks after a disastrous performance upended the presidential race, the Young Democrats of Rhode Island gathered to watch another debate. “I was a little nervous when Biden dropped out, but my fears are gone,” Henry Siravo, an 18-year-old member of the Young Democrats of Rhode Island, said during a break in the action. “I’m excited. ‘We’re not going back.’” Many of the young Democrats said they remembered President Joe Biden’s disastrous debate performance with Trump just a few weeks ago and shared Siravo’s feelings of anxiety ahead of the debate. But half-way in, Siravo said Vice President Harris was on top. | Expanded access to food stamps, health care becomes law in Alaska law takes advantage of waivers to allow more Alaskans to access federal aid programs More Alaskans will be eligible for food stamps and access to health care for school-age children and young adults will increase under a bill that became law without Gov. Mike Dunleavy’s signature on Aug. 30. Dunleavy sponsored the original bill, whose goal was to expand the services covered by Medicaid to include things like workforce development and food security. The bill takes advantage of a a federal waiver that allows states to consider the underlying causes of ill health. It was amended to include a proposal from Rep. Genevieve Mina, D-Anchorage, and Sen. Cathy Giessel, R-Anchorage, aimed at increasing SNAP access after the state’s Department of Health failed to process thousands of applications within the legal timeline in a backlog that left thousands of Alaskans without food aid for months at a time. Over the last two years, Dunleavy’s administration has added more than $70 million to state budgets to fight the crisis. The state Senate passed the final version of House Bill 344 by a unanimous vote and the bill passed the Alaska House of Representatives by a vote of 26-14 on the final day of the 2024 legislative session. | Young Democrats campaign in Georgia ahead of election \- With less than two months until the U.S. presidential election, young Democratic voters are becoming more engaged in politics and polls show they are fired up by the Harris/Walz Democratic ticket. | | Who wants Rep. Daniel Grossberg to resign? What Kentucky Democrats have said \- Several Democratic organizations and party members have called for Rep. Daniel Grossberg to resign following accusations that he behaved inappropriately toward women at the statehouse — though many elected officials have remained silent on the matter On Friday, the Louisville Young Democrats shared a statement on social media saying the organization condemns "all forms of sexual harassments expressed in the allegations." It called on Grossberg to take accountability for his actions and resign. "We call on the State, County, and Local parties as well as elected officials to stand up for a welcoming and safe environment free from harassment for all those involved in politics, especially young people who strive to be the next generation of leaders," the post read. | Congressman Frost visits Young Democrats at 'Back-to-School' event \- Florida Congressman Maxwell Frost spoke about the Harris-Walz campaign at a Young Democrats event in Tempe Frost spoke along with Keep AZ Blue co-founder Francesca Martin and Armonee Jackson, President of Young Democrats of Arizona and an ASU alumni. The representative was also joined by Isabel Hiserodt, a senior studying public policy, who acts as a role model for young voters at ASU, being the president of Young Democrats at the University. | Young democrat voters mobilize battleground districts across the tri-state - All 43 congressional districts within these states are on the ballot this November, and young voters are a pivotal voting bloc that can swing the election. The effort includes canvassing efforts in New York’s 3rd, 4th, 17th, 18th and 19th congressional districts, according to the president of the New York State Young Democrats. The N.J. Young Democrats president believes candidates should curtail their message toward securing women's reproductive rights and promoting diversity, equity and inclusion. | In North Carolina, Democrats counting on young voters - With Joe Biden's withdrawal from the race and Kamala Harris's arrival atop the Democratic ticket, the party activist says his generation -- a key voting bloc -- is fired up. Winning here will be an uphill battle -- the southern state has not voted for a Democrat in the presidential election since Barack Obama in 2008. "North Carolina is going to have something to say in November," said Zach Finley, the president of the Young Democrats of North Carolina. But for Harris to turn the state Democratic blue, the party needs to campaign "the right way, turning out the folks we need to," added Finley, who is also 25. \- 'Excited' - | Op-Ed: Santa Barbara Young Democrats Point Out Absenteeism of Councilmember - By Christian Alonso of the Santa Barbara Young Democrats The Santa Barbara Young Democrats are raising concerns about Councilmember Alejandra Gutierrez’s troubling record of absenteeism on the City Council. | Do you know a YDA chartered unit that should be highlighted in our next newsletter? | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

subject: My ancestors were real slaves in America
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE

Now, Democrats think I should be a slave to their politics |
---

Fellow American,

**My mom and dad are two foundational Black Americans. My dad was born in Omaha and raised in Detroit. My mom is light-skinned, but both her grandfathers are American descendants of slaves.**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=051ea7d9b1da405ca9a8b8a4efad01e8&_e=1oYoPK7X28C7uHTCnKITsQ5fbpFFonmVOH8cAHlVLioxI4N6Csdk9HEXL_Of5D5bMzRuzY1427PcdOU1B-spbIbvG7SV5qiVOs5Ui0gjCeS6oVJDlBTY8s8kMa-8Nk2xhfwV2500WgrL18v_tjaUVc4_7PVyWfoF6YHAjMq4lo4Hj1rbhUYwj2URypOsQo3F725Qj35TCKE4AwTYcC3-lJnTwi393xVhfVK5-uFZ2z6X9Irfwn0JNfstaqs3yh0Ez4vHOQ4bKKU8SkAwMRaXNyDJzyFcDGMpjy2JRo3rul6hrjIjkYWA-ltPmaHHpY1LI_qq4fNtVqwSW_57k6pL2Q%3D%3D)
My parents have always been a huge inspiration to me, and they made sure that I didn’t forget where I came from.

Now, the Radical Left and Industrial Media Complex think I should follow in my ancestors’ footsteps and be a slave to their politics. But, I’ll never forget my history.

Now, I’m a free-thinking Black Republican who is Hell-bent on beating Amy Klobuchar and giving the United States Senate a fresh voice as we look to Save our Country.

[**Will you donate any amount before midnight to help me win this race?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=051ea7d9b1da405ca9a8b8a4efad01e8&_e=1oYoPK7X28C7uHTCnKITsQ5fbpFFonmVOH8cAHlVLioxI4N6Csdk9HEXL_Of5D5bMzRuzY1427PcdOU1B-spbIbvG7SV5qiVOs5Ui0gjCeS6oVJDlBTY8s8kMa-8Nk2xhfwV2500WgrL18v_tjaUVc4_7PVyWfoF6YHAjMq4lo4Hj1rbhUYwj2URypOsQo3FrBvlWICywn7qtOVwMiwky-U--umtcwP4PrgqsTX1TunR_iEgmHETlmc-N6fklWKUK_dEsmrg8ktp615ZHVBC-5ouiXStY7Qm88d_m8q-iyytbrRk60524Bqg87hDxtxpuy0g96GJLizIwoZAdHNNWA%3D%3D)

**My final End-of-Quarter Deadline is here, which means it’s my last chance to show the American people how much momentum my campaign really has before the election.**

But, when I was looking over my fundraising numbers this morning, I noticed that we’re way behind our projections. This is terrible news. Once Klobuchar sees these numbers, she’ll step her foot on the gas with attack ads to try to close my shop up.

I’m determined to win; there’s too much on the line this November.

The only way I can recover is with your help. [**Will you chip in before midnight to help me beat my EOQ Deadline and show the Radical Left that a Free-Thinking Black Republican can win in Minnesota?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=051ea7d9b1da405ca9a8b8a4efad01e8&_e=1oYoPK7X28C7uHTCnKITsQ5fbpFFonmVOH8cAHlVLioxI4N6Csdk9HEXL_Of5D5bMzRuzY1427PcdOU1B-spbIbvG7SV5qiVOs5Ui0gjCeS6oVJDlBTY8s8kMa-8Nk2xhfwV2500WgrL18v_tjaUVc4_7PVyWfoF6YHAjMq4lo4Hj1rbhUYwj2URypOsQo3F5-FDEPRdnTPVinbbkf4ZiY__xDw5zQ3-AvcUOgvhPp9_UEHu5shSFP8a3ngl0VpdMUih71va2ba1Pu7FwiDXRtx1tbtgKUtIYcnXmhtw31TWjj4eJ9fJ8IQC9p87v8XbUPerAAHvI8bXyVH6E_Yxlw%3D%3D)

Royce White

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93487580/500653504/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2035-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTljMWNkZDUtYTU3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HgqsyqVN7WmTxPX0mZEWtGystjN2GyxfX-RS9CkirgI=)
Thank you so much for all your support and for standing with me in my campaign to flip Florida blue, friend.

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: September 24th, 2024
body:
California is impacting polls across the country on climate change.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to _Across the Country_ , our weekly series from No Dem Left Behind! We’re diving into the most pressing issues impacting battleground states as the 2024 election approaches. These are the stories shaping our communities, and it's more important than ever to stay informed. I’m Sabrina Niazi, and I’m thrilled to continue this journey with you! As a public policy advocate and activist, I’m dedicated to highlighting the issues that matter most across the U.S. landscape. Alongside my colleague Daniela Rodriguez, we’ll provide comprehensive analysis, highlight key trends, and deliver the data you need to stay informed on the ground.
---
| | | | **California**
---
|
---
As wildfires ravage the state of California, we are once again reminded of the devastating impacts of climate change on our environment, our communities, and our economy. These fires, which have **destroyed thousands of homes and displaced countless families** , are a symptom of the larger climate crisis sweeping the nation. This year alone, **over 2.3 million acres have burned in California,** exacerbating concerns about the increasing frequency and intensity of wildfires. But this isn’t just a California issue—**it's a national one**. Climate change is a growing concern for voters across the country, especially as extreme weather events become more common. Polls show that **62% of Americans are worried about the impact of climate change on their communities** , with 75% of California voters indicating that wildfires are one of their top concerns. This puts climate policy front and center for both state and national elections in 2024. California is not only the most populous state, but it also holds **54 electoral votes** —more than any other state in the nation. What happens here has ripple effects across the country. As voters across the U.S. see the devastation caused by wildfires and other climate disasters, they’re pushing for**stronger climate policies** at the federal level. National polling suggests that climate change could be a decisive issue in the upcoming election. A recent Pew Research poll revealed that **67% of voters nationwide support policies to reduce carbon emissions** and increase investment in renewable energy. In battleground states like Arizona and Nevada—where heat waves, droughts, and wildfires have intensified—voters are particularly attuned to the urgency of these policies, with **64% in favor of immediate climate action** . In California, the devastation from wildfires is reshaping the political landscape. Governor Gavin Newsom and local leaders have called for **urgent federal action** , while Democratic candidates are making climate policy a central theme of their campaigns. Meanwhile, Republicans continue to downplay the issue, with some labeling climate change as a “hoax”—a stance that is becoming increasingly unpopular with voters. **The stakes couldn’t be higher**. As the 2024 election approaches, voters are making it clear that climate action is non-negotiable. This issue, once viewed as peripheral, is now a core topic shaping voter sentiment. The California wildfires are just one part of the broader climate crisis affecting states from coast to coast, and **the electorate is responding**. Let’s continue to follow this issue closely as it plays a key role in determining not only California’s future but the **future of our nation**. **Stay tuned for our next update, where we’ll dive into more stories impacting the 2024 election. Stay informed with NDLB!**
---
|
---
-Sabrina Niazi
---
| | | | |
---
**No Dem Left Behind PAC** P.O. Box 15320 Washington, D.C. 20003

---

| | Peter, I need you to see this.

Even after Donald Trump tried to overturn the 2020 election results...

Even after he incited a deadly insurrection on our Capitol...

Donald Trump was granted “absolute” IMMUNITY for any official acts by his hand-picked Supreme Court.

It’s appalling, Peter.

And it’s never been more important we have a Senate Majority that will hold Trump and his Supreme Court accountable.

That’s why I’m going to make sure Kevin Cramer’s loyalty to Trump completely backfires by defeating him in November.

[**_But I’m going to need a wave of grassroots support – 1,000 donations before midnight – to expose Cramer’s MAGA allegiance once and for all, expand the Democratic Senate Majority, and replace Trump’s hand-picked Supreme Court Justices. Will you urgently chip in $15 to help me make Cramer regret ever standing with Trump? >>_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93490313/500659022/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20240924_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_rs_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzNiY2QyOWYtYTg3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gDGj4NbVU38I-ZNNfEZUGV1b0E1SD9EwpH6YzQrJogc=)

I cannot overstate the gravity of this situation, Peter.

I watched Cramer vote against convicting Trump for inciting the insurrection.

I watched Cramer vote to block Congress’ critical investigation into the attack.

I watched Cramer endorse Trump – even after he threatened our democracy countless times.

| | **For Immediate Release:** September 24, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**BAUGH STANDS BY CORRUPT ANDREW DO**
_Baugh Refuses To Condemn The Blatant Corruption Of His Political Crony_

**_“Andrew Do is the only candidate we trust and the only one endorsed by the Orange County Republican Party and he needs every one of our votes.” - Scott Baugh_**
**IRVINE, CA** — Orange County Supervisor Andrew Do is in hot water due to allegations of blatantly illegal political corruption — but his longtime ally Scott Baugh continues to steadfastly stand by him. Leaders across the county are calling for Do to step down amid [allegations that his nonprofit embezzled millions in COVID relief funds](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2b0c2eb4f7&e=7017cc100e). Yet Baugh has refused to comment on the situation, despite having glowingly endorsed Do in the past.

As reported by [Hannah Kang at the Orange County Register](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=4241e7fe66&e=7017cc100e): “Baugh, a former GOP Assemblymember and chair of the county Republican Party, has backed Do in the past. In a 2015 campaign mailer advertising Do’s candidacy in a special election for a board seat, Baugh, who was then serving as chair of the OC GOP said of Do: “Andrew Do is the only candidate we trust and the only one endorsed by the Orange County Republican Party and he needs every one of our votes.”

Baugh is no stranger to corruption, stemming back to [allegations of illegal conduct during his time in the California Assembly](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=31f35e6cbe&e=7017cc100e), resulting in more than 20 criminal charges (including 4 felony counts), and his role as Orange County Republican Party Chair at a time when [the OC GOP was caught up in a massive voter fraud scandal that led to 12 felony indictments](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=97e94873eb&e=7017cc100e).

“As the old saying goes, birds of a feather flock together, so it’s unsurprising that Scott Baugh– whose long political career has been marked by corruption and self-dealing– is standing by his longtime friend and fellow OC GOP crony Andrew Do,” said State Senator Dave Min, who is the Democratic nominee for CA-47 running against Baugh. “Voters deserve better than the same old political cronyism that has come to characterize the Orange County Republican Party. I’m proud to have authored SB 1111, which will crack down on exactly this type of corruption and help restore the public trust in our political institutions.”

SB 1111, which was recently signed into law by the Governor, was authored by Senator Min in the immediate aftermath of reports that Supervisor Do may have steered contracts to a nonprofit organization controlled by his daughter without disclosing her role or abstaining from the vote. SB 1111, titled the Restoring Public Trust Act, would require local officials to disclose when their child is a principal or significant owner of an organization receiving public contracts or public funds that the officials have influence over, and to abstain from voting on those contracts or funds. ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=925906dd60&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=54b0446f4d&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

* Grassroots donations allowed us to help 600 immigrant youth renew their DACA

* We launched a guide on how to get a driver's license when undocumented

* We hosted webinars and created step-by-step guides to keep DACA recipients and their loved ones updated on changes to the program

None of this would’ve been possible without grassroots allies like you showing up and turning out — sharing info to keep our community updated, writing to their members of Congress, attending rallies across the country, and donating to fuel our advocacy efforts.

| **ICYMI: WI-08 GOP Nominee Tony Wied Appears on Regular Joe Show**
De Pere, WI – Small businessman and Republican nominee for Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District Tony Wied today appeared on the [“Regular Joe Show”](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=7c68dbd74a&e=4c76b0e36b) and made his case for why he is the right person to represent WI-08.
Wied discussed his plan to go to Washington to lower prices, secure the border, and reign in out-of-control government spending.
He also blasted his opponent for being out of touch with WI-08 voters.
“My opponent has actively campaigned with those who call to abolish ICE and defund the police,” Wied stated, pointing to Kristin Lyerly’s recent campaign stops with extreme liberal Rep. Mark Pocan and the Democrat Socialists of America. “That is just too far left for the people of this district,” Wied added.
Wied also discussed his small business background and how he will take that experience to Washington to solve problems for the voters of WI-08.
“Voters need to look at both of our records and what they will find is that I am the right choice for this district,” said Wied.
Listen to the full interview [HERE](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=d4c0178baa&e=4c76b0e36b).

Something incredible happened on Friday.
**After weeks of ignoring requests for real televised debates with me, Josh Hawley gave in to the pressure to show up at a (non-fully televised) debate with the Missouri Press Association in Springfield -- after two new polls showed we cut his double-digit lead in half. **
Hawley stood on that debate stage and spread the same desperate lies about me that he's already spent millions of dollars to air on TV. **He 's terrified because he knows that we're in striking distance of taking back this Senate seat... and that there's nothing he can do or say to stop our momentum. **
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2325525-7bf9-4844-8d1b-64e6e1eb80c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And that's not where the day ended.
Just hours after the debate, we had one of our biggest campaign rallies yet -- with hundreds of Missourians in Springfield who are fired up to replace Josh Hawley on November 5th. The energy was absolutely electric:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/937c7e3f-e277-40eb-b1de-1a7ebb08468d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Two things are clear after what happened on Friday: **
1. **Josh Hawley is scared.** He'll try every trick in the book to tear me down and undermine the historic people-powered movement we've built together.

2. **We 've got the grassroots energy we need to win this race. **Between the huge rallies we've held across the state and multiple reports of this race getting closer, this is becoming one of the most competitive Senate races in the entire country this year.

I'm proud of everything we've accomplished together. And now, with just 42 days until Election Day, I'm ready to keep working and fighting to take back Missouri's Senate seat for real, everyday people.
Now let's get moving.

## Eye on the prize
On Sunday's Meet the Press NBC unveiled a new nationwide poll that showed Harris up 4 points. It became the talk of the town (DC that is). The state media wanted to make sure everyone understood that Harris was on the accent -- and was looking good.
The problem, as you know, we don't vote nationally. The next President will win after winning at least 270 electoral votes in each of the states.
While that poll from NBC garnered most of the media attention, another poll also came out that got far less attention BUT was far more important...

Lauren Boebert is a national embarrassment. After Beetlejuice-gate, she packed her bags and moved across the state to my district. Her political career was about to end, and she knew it.

Hello Friends,I’ve always believed in running a campaign rooted in **authenticity** —no gimmicks, no flashy distractions. That’s why you’re receiving our **first and only** end-of-quarter fundraising email. But I want to be clear: this one really counts.We’re in the final stretch of this race, and organizations are looking at these fundraising numbers to decide where to put their resources. This is our moment to show them that our movement is **strong, united, and ready** for the challenge ahead. Most importantly, with your help, we can reach our critical goal of getting our message on TV.Right now, we are **$59,165 away** from hitting the target that will put our ads on the air. Television is one of the most powerful ways to reach voters across our district, and we need to be in this fight on every front—on the ground, online, and on the airwaves.

This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f3228f023b95420face802&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_66f3223f023b95420facd1d7&l=en-US&s=6rqnfKsIem1Pqng3xRPlaV0eYtU%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”
---

|

Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. * * *
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93495511/500673954/-67972691?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240924_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWEwOTk3ZS1iNDdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6IazWH81E0drP2SHDHpGwcjEB9Pt45ymwSfh-ghq5cM=) I’m unafraid to call it how I see it: My opponent, Jim Marter, is a self-serving extremist MAGA Republican who lacks the courage, compassion, and ability to lead. Period. I’m also unafraid to meet the needs of working families in IL-14 and nationwide with the urgency, tenacity, empathy, and resourcefulness required. I understand the gravity of the position I hold and I take my duty to the people seriously. Montanans know that as a fourth-generation Montanan I will always put Montana first. During the Covid-19 pandemic, I ran for the Public Service Commission because I knew that Montanans needed strong public servants during one of the most difficult periods in our nation’s history. And, as President of the PSC, I have delivered for Montana’s families. As a small business owner myself, I know how important it is for government to work for the benefit of Montanans and Montana businesses. Government should not be encroaching on every aspect of our lives; rather, government exists to protect our freedoms. And that’s why I am running to be your next State Auditor. I want to protect Montanans from insurance fraud, help prosecute criminals, and fight to protect responsible use of Montana’s natural resources. But, Democrats are chomping at the bit to take control of this important state office. My opponent’s campaign is being funded by the very out-out-state corporations that he used to work for as a corporate executive. They are seeking to bring national liberal policies into this great state. And I am determined to stand in the way of turning Montana into California or Chicago!

#TeamLizzie keeps getting bigger! Recently, Lizzie earned the endorsement of the Black Economic Alliance PAC, the political arm of a nonpartisan alliance of Black business leaders and allies. BEA PAC is focused on advancing work, wages, and wealth across the Black community and supports candidates who prioritize Black economic progress and prosperity. Lizzie is proud to have been a BEA PAC candidate since 2018, and of the work they have done and continue to do together.
https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/ [https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/]
Also this week, Progressive Turnout Project, the largest voter contact organization in the country specifically dedicated to mobilizing the Democratic Party and defending democracy, endorsed Lizzie. PTP endorses candidates who support protecting the fundamental right to vote that’s central to its work as an organization, and we are thrilled they have endorsed Lizzie again this year. PTP has been an important part of our coalition since 2018, too!
https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/ [https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/]
Now available: new yard signs! #TeamLizzie yard signs are back. If you would like one, you can request a yard sign to be delivered straight to your door here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lfcyardsign24?refcode=lfcyardsign24_campaignupdate]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lfcyardsign24?refcode=lfcyardsign24_campaignupdate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lfcyardsign24?refcode=lfcyardsign24_campaignupdate]
As always, we have a bunch of great volunteer opportunities coming up this week. Our next phone bank [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678056/] is tomorrow, September 25, from 4-7 p.m, and our next postcard party [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678043/] is this Thursday, September 26, with shifts from 10 a.m. to noon and 6-8 p.m. They are super fun! | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Rice University, UT-Austin top Texas schools in U.S. News list,"** Dallas Morning News'**Sarah Bahari** -- "Five Texas universities nabbed spots in the top 100 of U.S. News & World Report's [annual list](https://substack.com/redirect/0593fd94-1dfb-468c-ae78-c64c44289a6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of best national universities.

Most of the top Texas schools fell slightly in the oft-touted [rankings](https://substack.com/redirect/32149d72-7a93-4ec2-a0e7-e2b88b84c612?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that some higher education institutions [blame](https://substack.com/redirect/07ff0a05-a805-428f-8d4d-3fd817003e5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for reinforcing the public's value on prestige in higher education. Private schools are better represented up high, and many public schools have jockeyed to improve their standings even as critics say the metrics don't fully portray a school's worth, especially for lower-income students.

This year, Rice University maintained its status as the highest-ranked university in Texas. The University of Texas at Austin, Texas A&M University, Baylor University and Southern Methodist University also landed in the top 100.

A list that pulls out public universities from the rankings shows Texas lagging in its representation, given the state enrolls the second-largest number of post-secondary students in the country with 90 percent of those students attending public schools. UT-Austin and Texas A&M were once again the only two Texas institutions in the top 50 for public universities, although the University of Texas at Dallas and University of Houston stayed in the top 75.

University of Houston saw major strides last year in President **Renu Khator's** mission to bring the school into the top 50, when it climbed 21 spots to number 70. Most of the top Texas schools fell slightly in the oft-touted that some higher education institutions for reinforcing the public's value on prestige in higher education. Private schools are better represented up high, and many public schools have jockeyed to improve their standings even as critics say the metrics don't fully portray a school's worth, especially for lower-income students. This year, Rice University maintained its status as the highest-ranked university in Texas. The University of Texas at Austin, Texas A&M University, Baylor University and Southern Methodist University also landed in the top 100. A list that pulls out public universities from the rankings shows Texas lagging in its representation, given the state enrolls the second-largest number of post-secondary students in the country with 90 percent of those students attending public schools. UT-Austin and Texas A&M were once again the only two Texas institutions in the top 50 for public universities, although the University of Texas at Dallas and University of Houston stayed in the top 75. University of Houston saw major strides last year in President Renu Khator's mission to bring the school into the top 50, when it climbed 21 spots to number 70. The university dropped to No. 74 this year, a result of U.S. News changing its ranking methodology and removing metrics related to the success of first-generation students, UH officials said. Only five points separate UH from the top 50, and school leaders say they expect their rankings to rise if they raise six-year graduation rates from 65% to 70%. * **TOP NEWS**

**" Rice University, UT-Austin top Texas schools in U.S. News list,"** Dallas Morning News'**Sarah Bahari** -- "Five Texas universities nabbed spots in the top 100 of U.S. News & World Report's [annual list](https://substack.com/redirect/fe7f2085-a0e8-4f2c-9d15-42161c9ea505?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of best national universities.

Most of the top Texas schools fell slightly in the oft-touted [rankings](https://substack.com/redirect/da5b4409-8f7e-4ccb-84a5-ad69ebf3b6d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that some higher education institutions [blame](https://substack.com/redirect/c2ea1949-83e2-4496-9bf6-7d62c789be64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for reinforcing the public's value on prestige in higher education. Private schools are better represented up high, and many public schools have jockeyed to improve their standings even as critics say the metrics don't fully portray a school's worth, especially for lower-income students.

This year, Rice University maintained its status as the highest-ranked university in Texas. The University of Texas at Austin, Texas A&M University, Baylor University and Southern Methodist University also landed in the top 100.

A list that pulls out public universities from the rankings shows Texas lagging in its representation, given the state enrolls the second-largest number of post-secondary students in the country with 90 percent of those students attending public schools. UT-Austin and Texas A&M were once again the only two Texas institutions in the top 50 for public universities, although the University of Texas at Dallas and University of Houston stayed in the top 75.

University of Houston saw major strides last year in President **Renu Khator's** mission to bring the school into the top 50, when it climbed 21 spots to number 70. The university dropped to No. 74 this year, a result of U.S. News changing its ranking methodology and removing metrics related to the success of first-generation students, UH officials said.

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. **Let's do some digging on the Pro-RCV group here in Alaska. Disclaimer from their most recent newsletter.****The Pro-RCV group appears to be the “Dark Money” they were so worried about, Arabella Advisors and 1630 Fund are about as “Dark Money” as “Dark Money” gets.**_**Their new Incorporation is their top donor.**__**Then "Article Four from Virginia"**__**Then "1630 Fund in Washington D.C."**_
---
This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f330b59cdfd34e59f171db&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_66f3303f5f5efd5effa58b50&l=en-US&s=so0Yc1BET8bOztTkubKhuwPZfSw%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”
---
Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. Expenditures and contributions by foreign-influenced corporations and foreign nationals.
** (a) A foreign-influenced corporation or foreign national may not, directly or indirectly, in connection with an election under this chapter, make a contribution or expenditure or make an express or implied promise to make a contribution or expenditure.

Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:Sec. 15.13.068. | Friend,
Last night, voters in PA’s 7th district had their third and final chance to compare Ryan Mackenzie and Susan Wild on the [debate](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=6ac3e0ca25&e=5ccada9200) stage. For the third time, Ryan Mackenzie was the clear winner. Wild once again struggled to justify her record of out-of-control prices, open borders, and international chaos. While Wild flailed, Ryan laid out his clear record of delivering wins for working families and corrected the record on Wild’s growing list of lies.
---
[Help us grow our Momentum](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=cab0925d5f&e=5ccada9200)
|
On energy, when Wild tried to hide from her record of price hikes, Rep. Mackenzie brought the receipts — recalling that Wild wrote him a letter asking that he vote for hundreds of millions of dollars in new taxes on natural gas in PA. When the subject turned to the economy, Wild tried to dress up her disastrous record, saying that she worked for six years to bring down prices. But Ryan brought the debate back to reality, saying, ‘If the Congresswoman has worked for six years to bring down the cost of living for people, she has failed.’
The highlight of the night, however, came near the end when Ryan Mackenzie once again called out Wild for mistreating, ignoring, and denigrating veterans, this time for ignoring a candidate forum held by a veterans’ organization. This is the third time in this campaign that Wild has been called out for her disgraceful treatment of veterans, and she responded by throwing her staff under the bus instead of taking responsibility.
See more about her treatment of Veterans [HERE](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=1b645ba762&e=5ccada9200) and [HERE](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=7676da26ee&e=5ccada9200)
**Wild also loves to claim that she is a bi-partisan congresswoman, well it turns out she has also not been so truthful with that. Read more**[**HERE**](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=8c6f45eed8&e=5ccada9200)
**Ryan is now 3-0 in these debates** , and it’s given us the momentum going into October. Now, I’m asking for you to help us do two things.
* First, I want you to watch this debate. ([Part 1](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=f8952a35bc&e=5ccada9200)) ([Part 2](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=b7de94897c&e=5ccada9200))
* Second, I want you to SHARE this debate online

Help us expose Wild’s record of failure and lies, and deliver the change that we need for the Lehigh Valley.

# _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 4_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

**1. Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ab8cb868ec&e=fc26432468)**.

**2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew**: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email [linnea@drewfornevada.com](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!).

**3. Volunteer for the Campaign:** #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit** **[THIS](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=03a2f15ef1&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

**4. Put up a Yard Sign:** One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign. Email your name and address to Carolina@DrewforNevada.com and we'll ship one at **NO COST** to you!

| Dear ,
We’re just under 6 weeks away from November 5th, and mail-in ballots will soon be hitting mailboxes in Allegheny County! A heartfelt thank you to everyone for your incredible support so far. But now, it’s time to kick our efforts into high gear!
**Join the Pine GOP Committee!**
I hope you’ll join me at the Pine GOP Fall Social and Fundraiser on Wednesday, September 25th, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM at the Pine Community Center. With a suggested donation of $20 per person or $150 to sponsor, your support will help Republicans win up and down the ballot in Pine.! For details, check out[ www.PineGOP.com](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=7b8a70dad7&e=8c80cba7e7).
---

Today, **[I'm asking you to join me and Mike Rogers to strike out the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff and Elissa Slotkin on November 5th.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f11f1d7e0d8b44368cb39c2eee6c7410&_e=CbGbwhTp5yTO4Yi6RoVgjyH35wikbIiRMtY5qHvR5hGgtj-KSBreG2C4nb8d-dsufUTXlHmhDeR5-I5sCgC8fRebhQCnsriMQ-u8HTVfnKOhAReoNlPmqAw2YoPib0L6lee38Hl5SsCdi6WNaYtBul9CH9pbD9ivdnzeVGyu_6M9laHj35zUpWTHudSbWGtrUIaqb72rxMxgB9Gvr0NzSWEvdbNAEBLkFuIC8TO0vYJBuyrnmqz-CGOIs_Jhxwi8fn5f3nIKqiHRkwphFqKu_-jx0_1D2jykm5czhNF6Ke9iZoXSdTyY1sYyOkg3kWu1qJPTBynrNcYGM1EmDtT-opNtgHUl6_Mvm8kscAAPFXzPLejTT-RYq-k1sBbCvOGQG9ByrD_Pi5cxQStQCJy6AZaeyhz5s5DdiJNrftTOunLsj5sn4Uqsah4wrraD1lFbjvYwRI7ZkJRCZLE1pCXuHg%3D%3D)**

Today, I'm asking you to help us start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come.

We're running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America.

You remember what it was like:

* Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?
* Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?
* Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember??

Democrat policies had brought America to its knees.

And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, _**["It's déjà vu all over again."](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f11f1d7e0d8b44368cb39c2eee6c7410&_e=CbGbwhTp5yTO4Yi6RoVgjyH35wikbIiRMtY5qHvR5hGgtj-KSBreG2C4nb8d-dsufUTXlHmhDeR5-I5sCgC8fRebhQCnsriMQ-u8HTVfnKOhAReoNlPmqAw2YoPib0L6lee38Hl5SsCdi6WNaYtBul9CH9pbD9ivdnzeVGyu_6M9laHj35zUpWTHudSbWGtrUIaqb72rxMxgB9Gvr0NzSWEvdbNAEBLkFuIC8TO0vYJBuyrnmqz-CGOIs_Jhxwi8fn5f3nIKqiHRkwphFqKu_-jx0_1D2jykm5czhNF6Ke9iZoXSdTyY1sYyOkg3kWu14QvjAZWKGZRP27SA6a8WD_FiyL1KRGfOKnn2dhNGE6oKvzEnjF9FopzUvVQE3JCp7_IC7oW9cEuUdedVx_ywFi0BXRHtsaJYBmfzkfDnSyO7H--qoLDlIciqLvaXaH0lNsRsTb-LdZI3g1FPgiJyWA%3D%3D)**_

There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. And at the same time, the cost of living is exploding due to out of control inflation and over-regulation.

Kamala Harris, Adam Schiff, Elissa Slotkin, and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent.

But listen, here's something I also want you to remember...

_**[_**We Republicans**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f11f1d7e0d8b44368cb39c2eee6c7410&_e=CbGbwhTp5yTO4Yi6RoVgjyH35wikbIiRMtY5qHvR5hGgtj-KSBreG2C4nb8d-dsufUTXlHmhDeR5-I5sCgC8fRebhQCnsriMQ-u8HTVfnKOhAReoNlPmqAw2YoPib0L6lee38Hl5SsCdi6WNaYtBul9CH9pbD9ivdnzeVGyu_6M9laHj35zUpWTHudSbWGtrUIaqb72rxMxgB9Gvr0NzSWEvdbNAEBLkFuIC8TO0vYJBuyrnmqz-CGOIs_Jhxwi8fn5f3nIKqiHRkwphFqKu_-jx0_1D2jykm5czhNF6Ke9iZoXSdTyY1sYyOkg3kWu1KNXnCRTVvdlRJG3lHJOsJQpNKdth9GZmwctE6zl38LtkphLUGPWu_bNDcxL1232Dl96cgekv-Nwq66iRGoJR2LHLePWyp7e63MkrIEHB3vpAioggaXkxZBeeC_EKzPnsN4BBEQDFgRSnKXZzn5sl2g%3D%3D)**_ pulled our country out of that 1970’s Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.

And _**[_**We Republicans**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f11f1d7e0d8b44368cb39c2eee6c7410&_e=CbGbwhTp5yTO4Yi6RoVgjyH35wikbIiRMtY5qHvR5hGgtj-KSBreG2C4nb8d-dsufUTXlHmhDeR5-I5sCgC8fRebhQCnsriMQ-u8HTVfnKOhAReoNlPmqAw2YoPib0L6lee38Hl5SsCdi6WNaYtBul9CH9pbD9ivdnzeVGyu_6M9laHj35zUpWTHudSbWGtrUIaqb72rxMxgB9Gvr0NzSWEvdbNAEBLkFuIC8TO0vYJBuyrnmqz-CGOIs_Jhxwi8fn5f3nIKqiHRkwphFqKu_-jx0_1D2jykm5czhNF6Ke9iZoXSdTyY1sYyOkg3kWu13cQe7p40rZKq0kLpBjYEDNRWnMBVc0wTId6lkFa2HPpdfLSH15DLp8ums8ju5YgjWLWeQy8oRGEWVAMh6E5lXtvi_Oo9G7sguPB3XGU-DAezX8986dkWVpHd3JHUqisI8seH_In4Z-OTDRfSbUWsig%3D%3D)**_ have the opportunity to repeat that same feat right in front of us here today.

MAKE AMERICA HEALTHY AGAIN
They Said Poison Was Food—
It’s Time to Fight Back
Dear Peter,
In 2004, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. was the darling of liberals and the Democratic Party establishment, an environmentalist unafraid to take on the biggest and most powerful polluters in America.
But over time, the Democrats began to abandon the ideals he believed in—peace, freedom of speech, honest government, and standing up for the working class. At first, the rank and file didn’t see it.
[**But as the years passed, the DNC became a tool of big money, the war machine, and the very corporations Kennedy had spent his career fighting.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=still_fighting_9_24_24_nd1&n=5)
Then Kennedy took up a new cause—children’s health and chronic disease. It was a natural evolution, because the same toxic substances—and the same corporations—that pollute our rivers, soil, and wildlife also poison human health.
**As a result, RFK Jr. became a pariah.** The liberal establishment turned its back on him. The media tried to silence him. And the Biden-Harris administration pressured social media to censor him.
Both Democrats and Republicans ignored the crisis of chronic disease and children’s health.
**But not anymore.**
America is waking up to the greatest crisis of our generation.
How can a nation be healthy if its people are not healthy?
The regulatory agencies have turned a blind eye to this, controlled by big money interests that profit from a sick care model. _Meanwhile, Big Pharma offers nothing but more pills._

name: Jill Stein
subject: Do better, Boeing.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Boeing strikers are standing strong as they rejected the company’s ‘final offer’ last night.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boeing_strike&n=1)
---
Peter,

One would expect that a company that’s spent most of their time bathing in controversy the last few years would want to avoid negative press and do right by their employees.

But that’s not Boeing.

Right now, more than 32,000 Boeing employees are on strike seeking to reverse decades of wage suppression and disappearing pensions.

Our campaign proudly held the line with them in Seattle last week.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boeing_strike&n=2)
---
**The union’s demands are very straightforward and deserve our full support.** For decades Boeing bosses have been squeezing workers’ pay, demanding higher output and stripping their pensions while dumping millions of dollars into politicians – Democrats and Republicans alike – to loosen regulations and look the other way on their increasingly cataclysmic disasters.

The result?

**The 737 Max was rushed to market and safety protocols were widely ignored over the fierce objections of employees who later became whistleblowers.** This led directly to two deadly crashes in 2018 and 2019 killing nearly 350 people.

In the wake of the 737 Max disasters, Boeing paid a “fine” that was a fraction of their massive profits and promised to do better, only to be found in default of their agreement with the Justice Department this year.

**Since 2019, Boeing has continued to ignore workers’ safety concerns** and push for increased production, shortcutting safety procedures and manufacturing standards.

This year alone, Boeing planes have seen **door plugs blow out mid-flight** , **wheels come off** during take-off or landing, a tire explode during routine maintenance and **kill two workers** – and that’s to say nothing of the two **astronauts Boeing left stranded in space** due to their faulty capsule design.

Through it all, the workers have tried to make Boeing do better. They have continued to work diligently under unrealistic conditions. When they saw substandard parts or missing parts in the assembly process, they spoke up – and repeatedly faced harassment and retaliation.

**Boeing remains one of the most profitable companies in the world** , the largest aerospace company, and America’s largest exporter by dollar value. **They can afford to build safe planes and pay their workers fairly. They choose not to.

****I’m here to tell Boeing: Do better, or face the consequences.

** Boeing executives have never faced the threat of criminal prosecution. The fines they pay are simply the cost of doing business, and they rest easy knowing that their political benefactors on Team Blue and Team Red will protect them from any real accountability.

That will change under a Stein Ware administration.

[**The regulators responsible for oversight of Boeing’s serial criminal conduct answer to the president, and you deserve a president who will put public safety ahead of corporate profits every time. Ours is the only pro-worker, pro-humanity, pro-peace and pro-planet campaign that will be on the ballot across the country this November. Can I count on your support to get our movement in front of every voter?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boeing_strike&n=3)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boeing_strike&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=boeing_strike&n=4)
---
Until then, we stand firmly with Boeing’s workers and echo their demands for a fair contract.

Last night Boeing put forth what they called their “final offer” – but it isn’t good enough. Boeing can and must do better.

**I’ve never taken a dime from corporate PACs or lobbyists, and I never will.

****We will fight for publicly financed elections so that their blood money can never be used to buy the silence or complicity of public servants.

** We will restore transparency and trust in our government institutions, and we will ALWAYS put people over profits.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---

Hi folks, Sherrod Brown here with an important update: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93502607/500695233/-422462239?refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240924_PM1_V1_S4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTM1MjNkNC1jNjdhLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EUD9e1xc_MoRW6d8PI0hRG9biaC9ff0RHeootPGnvdI=) A brand new poll shows that I’m losing ground to my GOP opponent in the most expensive Senate race in the country. My megamillionaire Republican opponent is gaining traction in Ohio — _and fast._ First, he self-funded $4.5 MILLION to his campaign. Then, Mitch McConnell’s super PACs made their biggest ad buy ever to plaster the airwaves in Ohio with attacks against me. **Now, we’re being outspent nearly 2 to 1 by outside special interest groups and my opponent is closing the gap.** National Republicans are going all in to flip this seat red, and we can’t expect them to let up. Look, unlike my wealthy opponent, I can’t self-fund this campaign. I don’t have right-wing dark money groups or GOP megadonors who can spend a fortune to tilt the scales in my favor. # Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended a number of Summit Carbon Solutions informational meetings regarding the carbon capture pipelines required by the Iowa Utilities Board (IUB) (which is now the IUC but it's the same entity) in order to stand up for our property rights, water, public health, and taxpayer dollars, and also attended a number of Iowa Democratic Party (IDP) regional Hall of Fame events. The Summit meetings I attended last week were in: Kossuth, Palo Alto, Clay, Osceola, O'Brien, Sioux, Ida, and Buena Vista counties. The IDP events were in Denison, Spencer, and Sioux City. I also attended a get together put on by the Cherokee Co Dems in Cherokee and one put on by the Monona Co Dems in Soldier. Additionally, I was invited to speak with the folks at the Greater Des Moines Partnership in Des Moines.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: I apologize for not getting a newsletter out last week, but I was so busy barnstorming our Congressional District. I attended numerous Summit Carbon Solutions informational sessions, which took up a lot of my time. I'm glad I went, however.
In a nutshell, these sessions started with Summit presenting the pros of their proposed carbon capture pipelines. Then, the IUC representatives gave a presentation on their role in the process (primarily as approvers of eminent domain for these pipelines). Next came the Q and A session, where anyone from the audience could come up and ask Summit whatever they wanted to in relation to the pipelines. This was the same format used at each session.
As you know, I've long been running against these pipelines. In fact, I may be arguably the first candidate for office that started to run against them dating back to early 2022, before most Iowans knew of them. I've written of my many reasons for opposition in newsletters past. I'm glad I attended, because Summit did not volunteer the reasons for concern regarding these pipelines. It was up to the audience members to bring those up. Even then, Summit representatives were well-prepped and were quite dodgy when being pressed, so you really had to be resilient and ask your questions in a precise way so they couldn't slip out from under your attempts at accountability.
Throughout last week, I posted a campaign social media recap of each session, focusing on the questions I asked of Summit. There's no easy way to do this, so I'm going to post my Facebook recap links here for each session. They are quite long, so if you don't have the time to read them, I understand. However, considering the battle over the carbon capture pipelines is a top issue of concern in my Congressional District, I encourage you if you want to know more about the issue to read them. I'll start with the oldest and will go chronologically as what I learned from earlier meetings helped inform what I learned in later meetings.
Hancock County Meeting (from a couple weeks ago): https://www.facebook.com/share/p/TD6Afwabez95SYaY/
Kossuth County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/A1FBSFQpMfZ5w5Ls/
https://www.facebook.com/meltonforiowa/posts/pfbid02xVxmcXBgxn2Aiqy1pHKGKVDerZQzGZvBzX2eH6oB66jTWt2myvoxkc3dtbzSBTm9l
https://www.facebook.com/share/p/zHvbPFdzwG3e4MST/
Palo Alto County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/A436v34q4tfgcesr/
Clay County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/ezKoveSxwXMZUhVp/
https://www.facebook.com/meltonforiowa/posts/pfbid0FWnbaGmYaBh9uUKGf5UkRYSVrmLNMV37M6K6D2FpnbLCfvYeAPbXWparXCk6aNjjl
Osceola County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/sKiZWrmMiMfPs9Wb/
O'Brien County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/v5EMnPhG3DqqmUMP/
Sioux County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/meltonforiowa/posts/pfbid0sYjtsVVUwfMbvVqAgWRAccgwtoC2MXPH5VCprZaZoQCYwviC9gDJ9pQxoqyn9X4wl
Ida County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/meltonforiowa/posts/pfbid0pK7neYVmqqQRCgwgvuqSUN2kCdoUr8AVTQt6PUF135o18CBYRMTU5PrvEzbW3i42l
Buena Vista County Meeting: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/A57N2rXm6QnJTH9c/
Our schedule for this week: On Monday 9/23, I attended a disability care forum put on by Nishna Productions in Red Oak, and then Zoomed with the IDP Rural Caucus on the way home. On Tuesday, 9/24, I was interviewed by Bret Hayworth of Sioux City Journal and Siouxland Media Fame for some podcast and news clips he'll be rolling out up to election day. On Wednesday 9/25, I'll be attending a Humboldt Co. Women's Get Together in Livermore in the evening after heading down to Des Moines for an interview with KCCI. On Thursday, 9/26, I'll attend the Emmet Co Dems monthly meeting at the Esterville VFW iat 5:30. On Saturday 9/28, I'll be speaking at the Coffee with the Candidate series in Nevada at 9 am at Copper Spaces before heading over to Marshalltown for a noon meet and greet at the Glick-Sower Hoouse, before heading up to Pocahontas for a 6 pm get together at Hinde. On Sunday, 9/29, I'll quickly check in at a meet and greet in Manning at 1 at the Timmerman Shelter House on HWY 141, before heading up to Algona for the Mertz scholarship get together at 4, before closing the week out at the Fort Dodge BBQ put on by the Webster Co Dems.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://www.nwestiowa.com/news/sioux-hears-another-pitch-from-summit/article_beedb982-79ed-11ef-8213-c7a2515b71fa.html
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton
