body:
Kamala Harris, Adam Schiff, Elissa Slotkin, and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. | | | Fellow American,
If you opened this email because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

But this email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's an email I never thought I'd be writing to you

Today, **[I'm asking you to join me and Mike Rogers to strike out the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff and Elissa Slotkin on November 5th.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=eb566611bebd41ffb4957162eceac3bf&_e=CKA-EvJBP65m6Pq8mTxjM0jQ_BZ7lMpL4QUVlSwPq0TEhmx68j2YpX5SkQk8anEWn3W_NykS2dZbfYmc_BBhQGSFgskpPK4tV22oCRlZVGjh_wZDdSfEYtxEBhX4G_h9Cy78s5TevKr4NAGcOYTQB2HJa4zaAGy7wO4vtXryz8Nbdbjq7b1NH59IQWIJHCWSujO5_Nj4D83k7Ss1ZDKbOrLPmZLfwUilEd5caAoNLht76cl8fB5Fn8gFbbaNOmHUXWvlMr6G4KCRzX20Sc_wR8OWL4nYItVNorbHkf3sXrvhOIY3geWIegrY0KhKf6LaOHYd8oYoxY7Z1USYlCIOAG99vPCm8ntikF8td-dyji42IlM6vPypv6vYPIPT16jeiVNMD9BHr4_HfYeqw3VxjhVyUYQ_XGc8SOTqdQy63H08z0jQ38x2ymNxt0J4pKvhBF1VsrORi93H76jYJ_EBXg%3D%3D)**

Today, I'm asking you to help us start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come.

We're running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America.

You remember what it was like:

* Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?
* Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?
* Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember??

Democrat policies had brought America to its knees.

And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, _**["It's déjà vu all over again."](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=eb566611bebd41ffb4957162eceac3bf&_e=CKA-EvJBP65m6Pq8mTxjM0jQ_BZ7lMpL4QUVlSwPq0TEhmx68j2YpX5SkQk8anEWn3W_NykS2dZbfYmc_BBhQGSFgskpPK4tV22oCRlZVGjh_wZDdSfEYtxEBhX4G_h9Cy78s5TevKr4NAGcOYTQB2HJa4zaAGy7wO4vtXryz8Nbdbjq7b1NH59IQWIJHCWSujO5_Nj4D83k7Ss1ZDKbOrLPmZLfwUilEd5caAoNLht76cl8fB5Fn8gFbbaNOmHUXWvlMr6G4KCRzX20Sc_wR8OWL4nYItVNorbHkf3sXruXNOB6QAuSexE58HG31EG_a8hZ_OXAFpdcDuz-GVu64Iu3H_WdMeE_bJ28Evq4y3dSoifq4iGsH9TPUkupIStszYRCk_FZMIIpHaE_CM-poZf4lN9q2UR5O2Yzl9MfFEcCsvb5wppxX_WkEXL-YfUkHORWHmvJgBzaDktmvOerFA%3D%3D)**_

There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. And at the same time, the cost of living is exploding due to out of control inflation and over-regulation.

Kamala Harris, Adam Schiff, Elissa Slotkin, and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent.

But listen, here's something I also want you to remember...

_**[_**We Republicans**_](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=eb566611bebd41ffb4957162eceac3bf&_e=CKA-EvJBP65m6Pq8mTxjM0jQ_BZ7lMpL4QUVlSwPq0TEhmx68j2YpX5SkQk8anEWn3W_NykS2dZbfYmc_BBhQGSFgskpPK4tV22oCRlZVGjh_wZDdSfEYtxEBhX4G_h9Cy78s5TevKr4NAGcOYTQB2HJa4zaAGy7wO4vtXryz8Nbdbjq7b1NH59IQWIJHCWSujO5_Nj4D83k7Ss1ZDKbOrLPmZLfwUilEd5caAoNLht76cl8fB5Fn8gFbbaNOmHUXWvlMr6G4KCRzX20Sc_wR8OWL4nYItVNorbHkf3sXrsXkh_HxGuiKSW6AkEiyHDKlApuwSIZ_LMNPC6AEqRvDTwxns6iq--NUw0jO0CVozgRrMaR36QSs7288XKYIz0hahqwSE4MnBoolaNrXG-XZurjLejlFjXQZ3gx8NEzPx8iX1gfXqRnVpiIXRz-agitUR7Esm2mJDUa46tphz-aug%3D%3D)**_ pulled our country out of that 1970’s Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.

And _**[_**We Republicans**_](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=eb566611bebd41ffb4957162eceac3bf&_e=CKA-EvJBP65m6Pq8mTxjM0jQ_BZ7lMpL4QUVlSwPq0TEhmx68j2YpX5SkQk8anEWn3W_NykS2dZbfYmc_BBhQGSFgskpPK4tV22oCRlZVGjh_wZDdSfEYtxEBhX4G_h9Cy78s5TevKr4NAGcOYTQB2HJa4zaAGy7wO4vtXryz8Nbdbjq7b1NH59IQWIJHCWSujO5_Nj4D83k7Ss1ZDKbOrLPmZLfwUilEd5caAoNLht76cl8fB5Fn8gFbbaNOmHUXWvlMr6G4KCRzX20Sc_wR8OWL4nYItVNorbHkf3sXrsgCmBj9RYHD1nVYYqBiGLptZ1IHFGcesy-UqGcqKmvpVWWQXSOQ0Blm0UAjcSwTPFn5wnxFDlPvxYmiahHCDz9hv2eNbv07gbvhuw3uLMkRBXLtAcUwtWR-fKqnOkpXEZY3PZimJE3q4lFMJ9SKSUpFdC4ua7IKaflWUfbXAv7wQ%3D%3D)**_ have the opportunity to repeat that same feat right in front of us here today.

It starts by stunning the Democrats with Senate wins in California and Michigan.

But there's no way we can pull it off without you.

**[That's why I'm asking you to rush in your $35 donation today to strike out Adam Schiff and Elissa Slotkin today.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=eb566611bebd41ffb4957162eceac3bf&_e=CKA-EvJBP65m6Pq8mTxjM0jQ_BZ7lMpL4QUVlSwPq0TEhmx68j2YpX5SkQk8anEWn3W_NykS2dZbfYmc_BBhQGSFgskpPK4tV22oCRlZVGjh_wZDdSfEYtxEBhX4G_h9Cy78s5TevKr4NAGcOYTQB2HJa4zaAGy7wO4vtXryz8Nbdbjq7b1NH59IQWIJHCWSujO5_Nj4D83k7Ss1ZDKbOrLPmZLfwUilEd5caAoNLht76cl8fB5Fn8gFbbaNOmHUXWvlMr6G4KCRzX20Sc_wR8OWL4nYItVNorbHkf3sXrturoM5yXbdBkGyZ0KzFqoR5HRcCkn3YK0SKDy0-6FqbwhU4TyeybdnHs_f1wefBBnEBcjjPlJNKGjlHCU-PmILeRegwsm5saXlzGtHfVCV0MkmBfHX0PQBJqPBRzTggFHg6qEzk_e-RCbgHd6E6ToXiCXQ8JAl291iRMxyGDvvdw%3D%3D)**

Adam Schiff and Elissa Slotkin have a radical plan for America if we can't defeat them.

---
1. Schiff and Slotkin want to abolish the filibuster. A dangerous move that would allow them to shove unpopular legislation through the Senate quickly.
2. They want to destroy the Electoral College so that Democrat coastal elites can decide the elections without the rest of America having a fair say.
3. They want to pack the Supreme Court with activist judges who will legislate their dangerous agenda with no respect for our Constitution.

Friend, it’s Derek. With only 6 weeks to go until Election Day, I wanted to take a moment to explain more about who I am and why I’m ready to fight for your family in Congress. [But first, if you already know you’re with me and prepared to flip CA-45 blue, will you take a minute to chip in to our campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93504591/500701625/-601345983?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024.09.24_b2_dt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTQxZjY0NWUtY2Q3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Q5ebc5hKUdBTsuBcNxZmUl_Bs8J_DN7kGWfBEQMYo48=) **It is summer in Orange County, which takes me back to long summer days as a kid spent working behind the counter of my mom and dad’s corner shop.** I spent most afternoons and summer days there as a kid. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93504592/500701626/-1909120420?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024.09.24_b2_dt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTQxZjY0NWUtY2Q3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Q5ebc5hKUdBTsuBcNxZmUl_Bs8J_DN7kGWfBEQMYo48=) I tease my parents about working for free, but looking back, I can see the virtues this experience instilled in me. Over a decade later, I had a professor tell me I could never be a lawyer because my English was not up to par. I was able to take my work ethic to my studies and prove him wrong - getting into law school and passing the bar. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93504593/500701627/-1909120420?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024.09.24_b2_dt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTQxZjY0NWUtY2Q3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Q5ebc5hKUdBTsuBcNxZmUl_Bs8J_DN7kGWfBEQMYo48=) When I look back at my life and how I ended up running for Congress, hard work has always been a running theme. Whether spending those long summer days at my parents’ store, to my tour in the US army, turned to long days in the library, and then finally giving the best legal practice to my clients. Hard work is who I am. **Now I am running for office for the first time in one of THE most competitive races in the country.** I am running against an incumbent who’s far right friends are pouring millions of dollars into defeating me. **It is not going to be easy. But I am ready to work hard because I believe CA-45 deserves a Representative who is willing to go to bat for them. ** [I have built a team that works just as hard - knocking on doors, making calls, and creating yard signs. But we cannot do it alone. We critically need your help as we head into the final five months of the campaign, so please, can you chip in to help send me to Congress to work hard and deliver results for your family?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93504594/500701628/-601345983?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024.09.24_b2_dt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTQxZjY0NWUtY2Q3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Q5ebc5hKUdBTsuBcNxZmUl_Bs8J_DN7kGWfBEQMYo48=) | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93504595/500701629/-601345983?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2024.09.24_b2_dt&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTQxZjY0NWUtY2Q3YS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Q5ebc5hKUdBTsuBcNxZmUl_Bs8J_DN7kGWfBEQMYo48=)

body:
End of month, end of quarter, end of Trump
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240924&t=1&akid=1222%2E587540%2Ep-faxR)
Peter,
The end of this month is _extra special_ this year because it marks huge fundraising deadlines for political campaigns across the nation. At midnight on September 30th, we are going to be closing the books on our end of the month (EOM) **AND** end of the quarter (EOQ) goals.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240924?refcode=em20240924&amount=5&refcode2=1222_587540_p-faxR&akid=1222%2E587540%2Ep-faxR)
_Double whammy, folks._
Legally, we will be required to report our quarterly fundraising totals publicly. Yeah, that means everyone can see how much support Leaders We Deserve has gotten this quarter - weirdos _(*cough cough* JD Vance)_ and all.
Why does this matter? Simply put: strong numbers = strong campaigns. This is the **_VERY LAST EOQ_** deadline before Election Day, and every dollar counts in this last stretch.
At Leaders We Deserve, we do not accept corporate donations. Instead, we rely on our community, which consists of fabulous people like you, Peter, to power real change at every level!
**👉 We’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 before midnight on September 30th in order to meet our 3rd quarter fundraising target.**

Thanks a million,
Leaders We Deserve
